It integrates low barrier pseudopotential channel design using multiple radio frequency (Multi-RF), multidimensional shortcut to adiabaticity dynamics, and constrained DC voltage optimization over the entire transport sequence. This framework connects waveform design, control, and computational validation, with smooth multichannel waveforms computed rapidly through a Karush-Kuhn-Tucker(KKT) linear system. The resulting waveform transports a single $^{171}Yb^+$ ion through a 90° turn in $5\mu s$ at an average speed of 14.6 m/s. Over 50 consecutive round trips, the final equivalent coherent phonon number consistently stays below 0.001, with no noticeable accumulation over time. System level evaluations at the QCCD scale show that the median duration of a single execution cycle is reduced by about $30\%$ across various circuit types. The fraction of execution time spent on transport decreases from approximately $70\%$ to $55\%$. This approach offers a means of designing fast ion transport waveforms with low phonon excitation for scalable QCCD based QPUs and provides a technical basis for efficient execution of quantum algorithms.

summaries.en: The paper presents a waveform-design framework for fast, low-phonon-excitation ion transport through 90° X-junctions in QCCD architectures, achieving 5 μs transport of a 171Yb+ ion with coherent phonon number <0.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种用于QCCD架构中90°X结快速且低声子激发的离子输运波形设计框架：实现171Yb+离子在5 μs内完成转弯且在50次往返中等效相干声子数始终<0.

title: Entanglement detection in dynamical quantum systems
abstract: Quantum science and engineering increasingly target the exploitation and control of large-scale dynamical systems. As system size grows, novel phenomena and quantum advantages emerge, but the resulting many-body dynamics become correspondingly harder to monitor and characterize. In particular, the underlying Hamiltonian often lacks symmetries, and the induced many-body dynamics quickly become hard to track. Focusing on one of the most important quantum features---entanglement---we demonstrate that, for a broad class of common Hamiltonian models, one can design effective witnesses that detect both the presence and structure of entanglement over relatively long evolution times. Inspired by stabilizer-based simulation, we track the evolution of generalized stabilizers of the underlying state and use them to construct linear entanglement witnesses. Through numerical experiments on Heisenberg-type Hamiltonians with up to twelve qubits, we show that the required number of measurement settings can be kept at a modest scale as the system size increases, and entanglement detection remains effective over evolution times that significantly exceed those accessible to naive approaches. The corresponding calculations can be carried out largely symbolically. Furthermore, unlike accurate state simulation, the stabilizer-based design of entanglement witnesses can be performed in a much more coarse-grained, digitized manner. We hope these results will stimulate further exploration of the quantum control of large systems.

summaries.en: The paper proposes stabilizer-inspired linear entanglement witnesses for broad classes of symmetry-lacking many-body Hamiltonians that can detect not only the presence but also the structure of entanglement over long evolution times using a modest number of measurement settings, with largely symbolic and coarse-grained (digitized) calculations demonstrated numerically up to 12 qubits in Heisenberg-type models.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出受稳定子启发的线性纠缠见证，用于一类缺乏对称性的常见多体哈密顿量，能够在较长演化时间内检测纠缠的存在及其结构，并在12个量子比特的海森堡型模型数值实验中表明所需测量设置数量随系统规模增长仍保持适度且计算可在较大程度上符号化并以更粗粒度的数字化方式完成。

title: Generative learning of time series with holographic quantum circuit sampling
abstract: Quantum generative models face growing qubit requirements and concentrated loss landscapes when learning long time series. Here we introduce holographic quantum circuit sampling (HQCS), which combines mid-circuit measurements, qubit reuse and independently parameterized temporal blocks to generate trajectories with a fixed number of qubits. For Haar-random HQCS and a normalized exponential kernel, we prove inverse-polynomial bounds on maximum mean discrepancy loss variance, contrasting with exponential concentration in global Haar-random generators. For generic members of a family of nonstationary Markov processes, temporal parameterization reduces exact-generation gate counts from quadratic to linear in sequence length relative to a specified class of repeated shared-block generators. Simulations demonstrate learning of Gaussian autoregressive processes and historical Volatility Index (VIX) trajectories, with the latter achieving over tenfold lower maximum mean discrepancy than the tested classical benchmarks. These results establish a framework for quantum time-series generation with fixed qubit requirements and provable avoidance of exponential loss concentration as sequence length grows.

summaries.en: The paper proposes holographic quantum circuit sampling for fixed-qubit generative modeling of long time series, proving polynomially bounded MMD loss-variance and showing that temporal block parameterization reduces exact-generation gate counts, with simulations successfully learning Gaussian autoregressive and historical VIX trajectories that outperform tested classical benchmarks.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种用于固定量子比特生成长时间序列的全息量子电路采样方法，证明了最大均值差异（MMD）损失方差的多项式上界，并表明时间块参数化可将精确生成的门数从二次降到相对于共享重复块生成器的线性，同时仿真在高斯自回归过程与历史VIX轨迹学习中取得显著优于测试的经典基准结果。

title: Criticality Concentrates Extensive Sensing Information into a Local Readout
abstract: We show that criticality concentrates extensive sensing information into a local trajectory. In the rapid-readout limit of an all-to-all dissipative feedback network, a single binary trajectory has a Fisher-information rate linear in $N$ for a common weak field, as does the full record. Critical slowing does not remove this gain because the local weight of the slow mode decreases with $N$. An analytic bound guarantees that the local record retains more than half of the full information across the entire channel-parameter range. We also identify how parameter drives and observation dynamics determine local access to collective information beyond permutation symmetry. Furthermore, our sparse-readout theorem establishes a $k^{-1}$ decay of fractional information loss: only $\Theta(\varepsilon^{-1})$ trajectories are needed to retain a fraction $1-\varepsilon$ of the full information rate. Any growing readout set, even of vanishing density, asymptotically recovers the full common-field Fisher-information rate.

summaries.en: The paper shows that in an all-to-all dissipative feedback network, operating near criticality in the rapid-readout limit causes a single local binary trajectory to retain a linear-in-N Fisher-information rate for a common weak field, with local readouts preserving >50% of the full information across parameter ranges, fractional information loss decaying as k^{-1} for sparse readout, and any expanding (even vanishing-density) readout set asymptotically recovering the full information rate.
summaries.zh: 论文表明，在全对全耗散反馈网络中于临界点并处于快速读出极限时，单条局部二值轨迹即可在公共弱场下实现与N成正比的费舍尔信息率，并且局部读出在整个参数范围内保留超过全部信息的一半；同时稀疏读出定理给出信息的分数损失随k^{-1}衰减，且即使读出集合的密度趋于零，只要随规模增长也会渐近恢复完整的公共场费舍尔信息率。

title: Riemannian Formulation of Sample-Based Quantum Krylov Solvers for Elliptic Problems: Energy-Norm Guarantees and Duct-Flow Applications
abstract: Sample-based quantum linear solvers measure quantum Krylov states $e^{-iAT}|b\rangle$ and reconstruct the solution of $Ax=b$ classically on the observed basis states. We develop this approach for positive-definite systems that arise from elliptic partial differential equations. We show that the sampling guarantees hold in any fixed basis with an efficient transform. We then replace the variational reconstruction by a Galerkin solve on the sampled set. For this reconstruction we derive expected and high-probability energy-norm error bounds, a sample complexity in terms of the smallest sampling probability on an essential set, a computable residual certificate, and a support-completeness theorem for the dephased outcome law. We formulate the method for elliptic problems on Riemannian cross sections. In two dimensions the stiffness matrix is metric-independent in conformal coordinates, and curved vessels lead to the same matrix class. Killing symmetries of the cross section give selection rules for the measurement outcomes, and the Lie derivative of the metric gives first-order bounds for geometric perturbations. We separate operator approximations, whose effect we bound, from sampler approximations, which affect coverage but not the target. As examples we treat the implicit step of pulsatile flow in elliptic, lens-shaped, and curved ducts. In simulations of up to 12 qubits, the number of Fourier modes required for 1% error grows from 14 to 60 while the number of unknowns grows from 64 to 4096. A classical residual-greedy selection is nevertheless more efficient than quantum sampling in all cases studied, consistent with the low measured sampling efficiency. On a six-qubit trapped-ion processor, the measured outcome laws follow a replacement-noise model whose strength grows by about 0.6% per two-qubit gate, and a parity selection rule rejects shots at the predicted rate.

summaries.en: The paper develops a Riemannian formulation of sample-based quantum Krylov linear solvers for elliptic PDE systems, proving energy-norm error bounds with explicit sample complexity and residual certificates while applying the method to duct-flow problems and validating it via simulations and trapped-ion experiments showing basis selection rules and noise-dependent measurement-law behavior.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了基于黎曼几何的样本式量子Krylov线性求解器，用于由椭圆型偏微分方程产生的正定线性系统，并给出能量范数误差的期望与高概率界、以最小必要采样概率为基础的样本复杂度以及可计算的残差证书，同时在导流管流动等应用中进行模拟与被困离子实验验证，展示了测量结果选择规则及噪声对结果分布的影响。

title: Two-axis twisting by two-photon exchange: rate, depth, and the self-Kerr constraint
abstract: The coherent exchange of pairs of quanta between two bosonic modes is equivalent, up to a numerical factor, to the generator of two-axis twisting, which attains Heisenberg scaling of the squeezing; we determine how much of that equivalence survives in a realistic nonlinear medium. In any such medium the exchange term is accompanied by a local Kerr nonlinearity, and within a sector of fixed particle number the Hamiltonian depends on a single dimensionless ratio of the effective Kerr strength to the exchange strength. We derive two criteria governing this ratio and show that they are independent. The first is the rate at which squeezing is generated: the exponential rate follows in closed form, vanishes exactly when the two strengths are equal in magnitude, and recovers as the square root of the detuning from that point. The second is the depth to which squeezing can be driven: at fixed particle number the attainable depth is a function of the anisotropy of the mean-field saddle alone, reaches the full two-axis-twisting value only for the isotropic saddle, and is independent of the rate, parameter sets sharing the same anisotropy but differing in rate by a sizeable factor giving depths that agree to every printed digit. The closed-form Gaussian dynamics reveals a pitfall: extracting rates from short-time data overestimates them by more than a factor of two unless the saddle is isotropic. An isotropic cubic nonlinearity imposes the value of the ratio where the rate vanishes, so realizing two-axis twisting by pair exchange requires detuning it; a moderate mismatch already recovers almost all of the optimal depth. We also explain why the constraint has not surfaced before: at two quanta the self-Kerr shifts the two coupled states equally, so the two twisting Hamiltonians are rigorously indistinguishable, the degeneracy being lifted only from four quanta.

summaries.en: The paper analyzes how a pair-exchange process between two bosonic modes implements (up to a factor) two-axis twisting with Heisenberg-limited squeezing in realistic nonlinear media, deriving two independent criteria—one for the squeezing-generation rate and one for the achievable squeezing depth—both controlled by a single dimensionless Kerr-to-exchange ratio, and showing that Kerr-induced constraints make short-time rate extraction and isotropic cubic nonlinearities require detuning to realize ideal two-axis twisting, with the self-Kerr ambiguity only appearing at four-quanta order.
summaries.zh: 该论文研究了在真实非线性介质中，两个玻色模之间的双量子交换如何等价地实现两轴扭转并产生海森堡标度的压缩，推导出由单一无量纲的克尔非线性强度与交换强度之比所控制的两个独立判据：一个决定压缩的产生速率（其闭式表达在两强度幅值相等时精确为零并随该点的失谐按平方根恢复），另一个决定在固定粒子数下可达到的压缩深度（只由均场鞍点的各向异性决定、仅在各向同性鞍点时达到理想值且与速率无关），并指出从短时数据提取速率会在非各向同性情形下显著高估，同时强调由于各向同性三次克尔会强制该比值使速率为零，若要实现理想两轴扭转需要失谐，而这种约束之所以以往未被发现，是因为在少于四量子时自克尔对耦合态的等量平移使两种扭转哈密顿量严格不可区分。

title: Violation of Bell-type Inequality in the Hanbury Brown-Twiss (HBT) Toy-Model: Quantum Correlations beyond Local-Realism
abstract: The Hanbury Brown-Twiss (HBT) effect marked a significant milestone in quantum optics by illustrating that intensity correlations can reveal inherently quantum features of light. Motivated by the structure of the original 8-mode HBT interferometer, we develop a simplified 4-mode toy-model that captures its essential physical ingredients while significantly reducing analytical complexity. Our toy-model provides an intuitive and well-structured framework for examining the desired correlation functions. We investigate whether our toy-model can exhibit genuinely non-classical behaviour by formulating and applying a Bell-type inequality tailored to its specific measurement configuration. Our analysis shows that the correlations generated by the toy-model violate the inequality, indicating the presence of non-local features that are incompatible with any classical hidden-variable description. The results highlight the power of simplified models in uncovering fundamental aspects of non-classicality in optical systems.

summaries.en: The paper introduces a simplified 4-mode Hanbury Brown–Twiss (HBT) toy model derived from an 8-mode interferometer and shows that its tailored Bell-type inequality is violated, evidencing non-classical correlations that cannot be explained by any local hidden-variable theory.
summaries.zh: 本文基于原始8模哈尼伯朗–特维斯（HBT）干涉仪的结构构建了一个简化的4模玩具模型，并通过为其特定测量配置定制的贝尔型不等式证明该模型产生的关联会违反不等式，从而表明其非经典相关无法用任何局域隐变量理论解释。

title: Quantum ordinal optimization under a fixed comparison budget
abstract: Ordinal optimization selects designs that are good enough rather than optimal when evaluation is expensive and the budget is small. The alignment probability measures the chance that the selected set contains at least a prescribed number of truly good designs. We formulate quantum ordinal optimization as a class of problems that maximize this probability under a fixed oracle budget. We study exact, coherent pairwise comparisons with one selected design as a first instance, with the budget counted in comparison queries. For every classical comparison budget smaller than the number of designs, we prove that a knockout among uniformly sampled designs attains the optimum. The sample is drawn without replacement and contains one more design than the number of comparisons. For a uniformly random order, the selected design's rank has a polynomial probability law. At the same comparison budget, the maximum quantum degree is at most twice the classical maximum, a factor attained whenever there are more than twice as many designs as comparisons, so a quantum algorithm can realize rank laws that no classical algorithm with the same budget can. We determine the exact quantum optimum with one comparison for every number of designs and every good-enough set. For selecting the best of n designs, the optimal success probability with one quantum comparison is approximately 3.30/n for large n, compared with 2/n for one classical comparison. When the best design is sought, one quantum comparison gives a higher alignment probability than two classical comparisons whenever there are more than nine designs.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Systems and Control (eess.SY); Optimization and Control (math.OC)

summaries.en: The paper formulates quantum ordinal optimization as maximizing the probability that a selected set contains at least a required number of truly good designs under a fixed number of comparison-oracle queries, proving optimality results for classical knockout schemes and characterizing how quantum algorithms can achieve strictly stronger rank and alignment probability laws, including an approximate 3.
summaries.zh: 论文将量子序数优化表述为：在固定的比较型查询预算下最大化所选集合包含至少规定数量真正优良设计的概率，证明了经典“淘汰赛”方案在给定预算下的最优性并刻画了量子算法如何在排序与对齐（alignment）概率规律上实现经典同预算无法达到的更强性能，例如在大规模 n 中用一次量子比较寻找最佳设计的成功率约为 3.

title: End-to-End Fidelity and Rate Analysis for Zero-Added-Loss Multiplexing
abstract: Zero-added-loss multiplexing (ZALM)~[Phys. Rev. Appl. {\bf 19}, 054029 (2023)] is a midpoint-source scheme for entanglement distribution. Its quantum transmitter (QTX) employs two Sagnac sources of polarization-entangled pairs plus partial Bell-state measurements (BSMs) on their idler outputs to herald entanglement in their signal outputs, thus avoiding the switching losses suffered by other multiplexing approaches. When its Sagnac sources' spontaneous parametric downconverters (SPDCs) utilize $\chi^{(2)}$ crystals with phase-matched spectral islands, ZALM avoids the tradeoff between heralding efficiency and output-state fidelity incurred when conventional-crystal SPDCs' outputs are channelized by dense wavelength-division multiplexing filters. This paper reports an end-to-end fidelity and rate analysis for islands-based ZALM that includes: SPDC multipair emissions of all orders and partial-BSM losses in the ZALM QTX; loss in propagation from the ZALM QTX to Alice and Bob's quantum receivers (QRXs); loss and mode mismatch in the mode converters employed at Alice and Bob's QRXs; and loss in the partial-BSM loading of Alice and Bob's emissive quantum memories.

summaries.en: The paper provides an end-to-end analysis of entanglement-distribution fidelity and rates for a zero-added-loss multiplexing (ZALM) scheme that uses island-phase-matched χ(2) SPDC sources in a midpoint-source transmitter with partial Bell-state measurements, accounting for multipair emissions, heralding losses, channel and receiver conversion losses/mode mismatch, and memory loading losses.
summaries.zh: 本文对一种零额外损耗复用（ZALM）中点源纠缠分发方案进行了端到端保真度与速率分析，该方案在发射端用含岛相位匹配的χ(2) SPDC源及其幂级产生与部分贝尔态测量来无交换损耗地产生纠缠，并考虑多光子对发射、部分BSM损失、从发射端到Alice/Bob传输损耗、接收端模式转换的损耗与模匹配失配，以及Alice和Bob发射量子存储器装载过程中的损失。

title: Quantum simultaneous decoding via pretty-good measurements of tilted states
abstract: A multiple-access channel transmits messages from several senders to one receiver. For quantum outputs, the receiver must distinguish states depending on all messages, while tests for different decoding errors may not commute. In this paper, we give a self-contained account of simultaneous decoding, in which one joint measurement recovers the messages at the established achievable rates using independent codebooks. The proof combines Sen's tilted-subspace method with Cheng's analysis of the pretty-good measurement, a standard measurement for distinguishing quantum states. Auxiliary labels close to a common reference state separate the geometric directions associated with different errors. A Gram-matrix bound then allows separately chosen binary tests to certify the performance of one measurement. The labels are removed from the completed decoder, leading to a deterministic packing theorem that applies to finite state ensembles, including unequal priors. We develop the two-sender case first, with worked examples and figures, before treating any fixed number of senders. Sharper finite-error guarantees for the same decoder are developed separately, with sharp bounds for two specified steps of the analysis rather than a claim of globally optimal decoding. Applications recover known achievable rates for unassisted and entanglement-assisted classical communication, distributed classical compression with quantum side information, and coherent-state communication through a beamsplitter or passive multiport device. The common proof makes the geometric mechanism and its quantitative consequences available without repeating the construction for each application.

summaries.en: The paper presents a self-contained simultaneous-decoding framework for quantum multiple-access channels that uses pretty-good measurements combined with Sen’s tilted-subspace method to achieve joint recovery of multiple senders’ messages at established rates and derives deterministic finite-ensemble packing theorems with applications including classical communication with/without entanglement, distributed compression with quantum side information, and coherent-state communication through linear optical devices.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种适用于量子多用户信道的同时解码框架：利用结合Sen的倾斜子空间方法与Cheng对pretty-good测量的分析，借助几何标签分离不同错误对应的方向，并通过Gram矩阵界为同一测量分别验证性能，从而在独立码本下以既有可达速率实现多发送方消息的联合恢复，最终给出对有限态集合（含不等先验）的确定性装箱定理，并应用于无辅助/有纠缠辅助的经典通信、带量子侧信息的分布式压缩以及通过分束器或被动多端口器件的相干态通信。

title: Adaptive Entanglement Witnessing for Two-Qubit Systems
abstract: Entanglement witnesses are a key instrument in determining the entanglement of unknown bipartite qubit systems without requiring a full tomography. Riccardi et al. (2020) proposed a set of two-qubit witnesses, denoted $\{W^3\}$, which require a set of local measurements in three bases. In this work we propose an additional set of witnesses, denoted $\{W^5\}$, that build on $\{W^3\}$ and require measurements in two additional bases. We present an adaptive two-step method that uses the measurement results obtained for $\{W^3\}$ to select which $W^5$ to evaluate. We computationally demonstrate that our adaptive two-step protocol can identify 72% of entangled states generated according to the methods of Roik et al. (2021) while requiring measurements in only five of the nine bases needed for full quantum tomography. Additionally, we experimentally verify the behavior of both sets of witnesses using polarization-entangled photon pairs.

summaries.en: The paper proposes an adaptive, two-step entanglement-witnessing scheme for two-qubit systems that extends Riccardi et al.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出一种针对双量子比特系统的自适应、两步式纠缠见证方法，将Riccardi等人的{W^3}见证扩展为新的{W^5}见证集合，并通过只需测量5个基（而非全量子态层析所需的9个基）来识别72%的特定纠缠态，同时使用偏振纠缠光子对对两组见证的行为进行了实验验证。

title: Multipolar Nanophotonics with Quantum Computers
abstract: Small particles respond to light through electric and magnetic patterns called multipoles. Their interference determines the direction of scattered light and affects the decay of nearby emitters. Larger nanoantenna arrays, metasurfaces, and other nanophotonic systems demand increasingly costly simulations to meet strict performance and reliability requirements. We show how to represent these responses with quantum bits (qubits) and use quantum circuits to calculate scattering and the Purcell effect, the change in an emitter's decay rate caused by its surroundings. The circuits can encode known multipoles or estimate unknown ones from Maxwell's equations at the particle surface. We test the method against classical theory using an ideal quantum simulator and real IBM and IonQ quantum computers. For a silicon nanoparticle of radius 78 nm illuminated at 679 nm, IonQ gives a forward directivity of 2.984, close to the ideal dipolar value 3, quantifying the concentration of scattered light in the forward direction. For an emitter 10 nm from a gold nanoparticle and emitting at 510 nm, IBM measurements yield a calculated total decay rate 20.48 times its vacuum value versus 20.47 from theory, with correction for errors in reading the qubit states. We also establish how the number of multipoles and the required accuracy set the demands on qubits and measurements. These results motivate quantum-assisted design studies of directional radiation and emitter decay in nanophotonic systems.

summaries.en: The paper presents a qubit-based quantum-circuit method to compute nanophotonic multipolar scattering and Purcell-effect decay rates, validated on both classical theory and real IBM/IonQ quantum computers with quantitative agreement for forward directivity and emitter decay near silicon and gold nanoparticles.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出一种基于量子比特与量子电路的方法，用于计算纳米光子多极散射与普尔塞尔效应（发射体衰减率变化），并通过理想量子模拟及真实的IBM和IonQ量子计算机对硅与金纳米颗粒附近的前向指向性和发射体衰减率等结果进行验证，给出与经典理论的定量一致性，同时讨论多极数量与精度需求对量子比特与测量负担的影响。

title: QIAP: A Quantum-Inspired Authentication Protocol with BB84-Based Channel Monitoring
abstract: Authentication in quantum-aware communication settings requires mechanisms that verify user legitimacy while also assessing whether the communication channel exhibits excessive disturbance. This paper presents QIAP, a stateful hybrid framework that combines classical commitment-based challenge-response authentication with BB84-based quantum-channel monitoring. QIAP uses a dual-branch verification structure inspired by rectilinear and diagonal basis selection. In the rectilinear branch, the prover opens a hash-based commitment and the verifier checks consistency with the registered round token. In the diagonal branch, the prover returns an HMAC tag bound to the verifier nonce, round identifier, and submitted commitment without disclosing the round-specific sub-secret. Under the stated hash, HMAC, freshness, secure-registration, protected-storage, and high-entropy-secret assumptions, QIAP provides computational resistance to the modeled wrong-secret and replay attempts and protects the long-term master secret from direct recovery. After successful authentication, the BB84 module estimates the quantum bit error rate (QBER) and aborts the session when the measured value reaches or exceeds the configured threshold. In the reported simulation, no successful authentication was observed among 1,000 tested wrong-secret attempts per branch. The baseline and full intercept-resend conditions produced mean QBER values of approximately 0.02 and 0.25, respectively. The classical authentication stage required approximately 0.6 ms, and the implemented authentication messages required approximately 113 bytes per round. These results indicate that QIAP can provide a lightweight hybrid framework for combining secret-based identity verification with QBER-based channel-disturbance assessment under the stated threat model.

summaries.en: The paper proposes QIAP, a stateful hybrid authentication protocol that uses classical hash-based challenge-response with BB84-inspired dual-branch verification plus BB84 channel monitoring to estimate QBER and abort on excessive disturbance, providing computational resistance to wrong-secret and replay attacks while protecting the master secret under specified cryptographic assumptions.
summaries.zh: 论文提出QIAP，这是一种有状态的混合认证协议，将基于哈希承诺的经典挑战-应答与受BB84启发的双分支校验相结合，并通过BB84信道监测估计QBER，当超过阈值时中止，从而在给定密码学假设下对错误密钥与重放攻击具有计算抵抗能力并保护主密钥。

title: Device-to-protocol simulation of spectrally-resolved quantum photonic circuits
abstract: Predicting quantum-photonic circuit performance requires retaining source and device physics without making photon-counting calculations prohibitively expensive. Here we present PhoQuS, a framework that combines frequency-resolved source models, electromagnetic compact models and spatially correlated fabrication variation to simulate quantum photonic circuits. Covariance-Gram reduction after full-resolution Gaussian propagation lowers readout cost while retaining dominant spectral correlations. For continuous-variable state preparation, spectral reduction accelerates photon counting by 60.4-fold in an approximate Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill circuit. Frequency-resolved modeling guides the use of cascaded squeezing with temporal walk-off compensation, yielding 0.99 fidelity to the single-mode circuit reference and 0.98 conditional purity in lossless simulations. For discrete-variable state preparation, simulations of three-photon Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger circuits across a virtual wafer show that component robustness alone does not predict circuit fidelity, which depends jointly on source spectra, circuit architecture and control. PhoQuS connects device physics to protocol-level performance through a unified workflow that retains spectral detail while reducing readout cost.

summaries.en: The paper introduces PhoQuS, a framework for efficiently simulating spectrally resolved quantum photonic circuits by combining frequency-resolved source models, electromagnetic compact models, and spatially correlated fabrication variation, using covariance-Gram reduction to keep key spectral correlations while greatly lowering photon-counting readout cost and enabling accurate continuous- and discrete-variable performance predictions.
summaries.zh: 论文提出PhoQuS框架，通过结合频率分辨的光源模型、电磁紧凑模型以及具有空间相关性的器件工艺偏差，并利用协方差Gram降维在保留主要光谱关联的同时显著降低光子计数读出成本，从而实现对连续变量与离散变量量子光子电路的高效且准确性能仿真。

title: Time-Frequency Continuous-Variable Quantum Teleportation with Single Photons
abstract: Quantum teleportation, a key building block for quantum technologies, enables distant parties, Alice and Bob, to transfer an unknown quantum state using entanglement, local operations, and classical communication. In this work, we propose a quantum teleportation protocol for single-photon time-frequency continuous variables, where time is the time of arrival at a detector. We detail the operational requirements of the protocol, notably the nonlinear interactions needed for the photon-photon time-frequency entangling gate. By explicitly treating the detector position as the reference frame for time of arrival, we show that, even with ideal classical and quantum channels, the input-output fidelity is not unity unless the receiving party can correct the detector-position mismatch. This results in a trade-off between teleportation fidelity and the temporal bandwidth of the input photon wavepacket. The protocol itself can be used for remote detector synchronization. In particular, we show that time-frequency cat and Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill states provide an internal temporal ruler through fidelity revivals. We further derive the classical and best-copy fidelity thresholds for single-photon Gaussian wavepackets, finding that the relevant vacuum-equivalent shot noise is input-dependent, in contrast with quadrature-based continuous-variable quantum teleportation. Our proposal derives from a quantum theory of space-time events, whereafter we establish space as a reference for the time degree of freedom, thereby grounding our work in ongoing research on reference frames and superselection rules in quantum optics and quantum information. Beyond protocols harnessing time-frequency continuous variables of single photons, this work points toward remote synchronization in quantum communication architectures.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a time-of-arrival, time-frequency continuous-variable quantum teleportation protocol for single photons, analyzes the required nonlinear photon-photon entangling gate and reference-frame effects that prevent unit fidelity unless detector-position mismatches are corrected, and derives fidelity thresholds and uses for remote detector synchronization, including internal “temporal rulers” from cat and Gottesman–Kitaev–Preskill states.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种针对单光子的到达时间表征的时频连续变量量子传输方案，详细分析所需的非线性光子-光子纠缠门以及因参考系（如探测器位置不匹配）导致的非单位保真度条件，并给出保真度阈值计算，同时展示该方案可用于远程探测器同步及利用猫态和GKP态构建“内部时间标尺”。

title: Collective Floquet engineering between two distant superconducting artificial atoms
abstract: A one-dimensional waveguide is a crucial medium for transferring propagating quantum information between remote qubits, yet the photon-mediated interaction is typically fixed by the static device geometry, qubit parameters, and their couplings to the transmission line. Such an interaction can be engineered to be coherent or dissipative via virtual- or real-photon exchange, respectively, yet its effective strength remains fixed in either case. Here we demonstrate dynamical control over this interaction by applying Floquet engineering to two superconducting qubits coupled to a waveguide terminated by a capacitive mirror. By positioning one qubit at an antinode and the other qubit at a node or an antinode of the resonant standing wave, we realize a Hermitian or non-Hermitian coupling between the two qubits. A periodic flux drive of the qubit frequencies then enables on-demand control of the coherent energy splitting and the collective decay. Our results establish Floquet engineering as a route to dynamically reshape both coherent and dissipative photon-mediated interactions between remote quantum emitters.

summaries.en: The paper shows that Floquet engineering can dynamically switch and tune the coherent (Hermitian) and dissipative (non-Hermitian) photon-mediated interactions between two distant superconducting qubits in a waveguide terminated by a capacitive mirror by placing them at specific standing-wave nodes/antinodes and applying periodic frequency flux drives.
summaries.zh: 该论文通过在由电容镜终止的波导中将两个远距离超导量子比特分别放置在驻波的节点/腹部并施加周期性的频率通量驱动，展示了用Floquet工程按需调控它们之间介导相互作用的相干（厄米）与耗散（非厄米）分量，从而实现对集体能级分裂和集体衰减的动态重塑。

title: Metasurface quantum graphs for polarization-independent certified randomness
abstract: Quantum random number generators are crucial for information security, yet existing implementations are hindered by bulky optics, device imperfections, and state alignment constraints. Here, using a compact metasurface platform, we achieve polarization-independent certified randomness by establishing a quantitative quantum graph framework. By mapping multi-channel nanophotonic responses onto graph vertices, we assign metasurface measurements an operational information-theoretic meaning, directly connecting weighted graph degrees to conditional min-entropy estimation. The resulting graph-certified measurements yield robust private randomness even under entanglement-based attacks without complex optics. Experimentally, we fabricate 4- and 6-channel dielectric metasurfaces to implement high-dimensional positive operator-valued measure graphs, successfully certifying randomness with heralded single photons and Poissonian light. By integrating complex quantum measurements into a single passive layer, our metasurface quantum graphs provide a scalable route for integrated quantum technologies.

summaries.en: The paper presents compact polarization-independent metasurface quantum graphs that map nanophotonic measurement outcomes to quantum-graph-based min-entropy bounds, enabling certified private randomness robust to entanglement attacks using multi-channel devices without complex optical alignment.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种紧凑的极化无关“元表面量子图”方案，将纳米光子测量响应映射到基于量子图的最小熵估计，从而在无需复杂光学对准的情况下实现对纠缠攻击鲁棒的认证私有随机性，并用4/6通道介电元表面实验验证高维POVM图的随机性认证。

title: Finite-time quantum equilibration from local correlations
abstract: An isolated quantum system evolves reversibly, yet a small subsystem can lose nearly all information about its initial state. Conserved quantities may retain some of this information, depending on how strongly they overlap with local observables. Here we consider a subsystem in an arbitrary initial state coupled to a maximally mixed bath. We show that the worst-input mean-square equilibration error, maximised over window origins, is bounded from above and below by the mean square of a complete local autocorrelation, with the stationary part subtracted. A correlation record over a finite interval therefore controls the equilibration error in every interval of the same length. The result allows arbitrary degeneracies of energies and gaps. We apply it to two static Hamiltonian families. For fixed spin subsystems in the one-particle sector of a bounded-range periodic clock, fixed-accuracy thermalisation is guaranteed on windows that grow only slightly faster than linearly with system size, despite exponentially small positive energies. A random commuting model with logarithmic interaction range retains an extensive set of conserved observables. Its expected mean-square error is bounded by a finite-size term and an inverse-time term. The inverse-time dependence is unavoidable because of the initial transient. These examples show how local relaxation can coexist with exact conservation laws and a finely spaced spectrum.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Statistical Mechanics (cond-mat.stat-mech); Strongly Correlated Electrons (cond-mat.str-el); Mathematical Physics (math-ph)

summaries.en: The paper proves that in an isolated quantum system equilibrating under a maximally mixed bath, the worst-case finite-time mean-square equilibration error over any window of fixed length is tightly controlled by the local autocorrelation function (with its stationary part removed), enabling analysis even with arbitrary energy/gap degeneracies and yielding applications where thermalization persists despite exact conserved quantities and very small energy gaps.
summaries.zh: 本文证明：在与最大混合浴耦合的孤立量子系统中，考虑任意长度窗口内最坏输入的有限时间均方平衡误差时，它可由去除平稳部分后的局域自相关函数紧密地上下界定，并据此处理任意能级与能隙简并；进一步的应用表明，即使存在精确守恒量且能隙极小，局域弛豫仍可实现固定精度的热化，并分析了随机对易模型中误差随时间的不可避免的逆时间依赖性。

title: Pathfinder-BP: A Low-Latency Recursive Decoder for Topological Codes
abstract: We propose Pathfinder-BP, a recursive decoder for topological quantum codes that combines belief propagation with controlled bit-flipping. An initial BP pass identifies and permanently fixes high-confidence errors. Upon convergence failure, the decoder recursively explores alternative error patterns by tentatively flipping low-confidence variables. On surface codes, Pathfinder-BP achieves a noise threshold and logical error rate comparable to minimum-weight perfect matching (MWPM). A crucial advantage of Pathfinder-BP is its highly parallelizable structure, which yields a worst-case decoding latency quasi-linear in the code distance, making it a suitable candidate for low-latency hardware implementation.

summaries.en: Pathfinder-BP is a low-latency recursive decoding scheme for topological quantum codes that combines belief propagation with controlled bit flips to permanently correct high-confidence errors and recursively explore lower-confidence alternatives on failure, achieving thresholds and logical error rates on surface codes comparable to MWPM with a quasi-linear parallelizable latency in code distance for hardware suitability.
summaries.zh: Pathfinder-BP 是一种用于拓扑量子码的低延迟递归译码方法，将基于置信传播（BP）的初始修正与受控比特翻转结合：先对高置信度错误进行永久修复，若收敛失败则对低置信度变量进行试探性翻转并递归搜索替代误差模式；在表面码上，其噪声阈值和逻辑错误率与最小权完美匹配（MWPM）相当，并且具有高度可并行的结构，使最坏译码延迟随码距离准线性增长，适合硬件实现。

title: Magic-Free Certification of Logical Error Rates in Universal Fault-Tolerant Circuits
abstract: As quantum hardware enters the fault-tolerant regime, algorithms are beginning to be executed on encoded qubits, yet scalable certification of how well they run remains an open problem. Here we introduce magic-free certification, a certification protocol for universal fault-tolerant circuits that consumes no magic, the resource that generally places them beyond efficient classical simulation and is by far the most expensive element of a fault-tolerant computation. The protocol is code- and decoder-agnostic, runs interleaved with the target circuit on the same device, and has a sample complexity that grows linearly with the number of logical qubits and non-Clifford gates while remaining decoupled from the logical error rate itself. Given a predefined error tolerance $p_L^*$, the protocol determines at a chosen confidence level whether the device executes the target circuit at a logical error rate below $p_L^*$. The method relies on trap circuits, copies of the target with every magic state replaced by a stabilizer state, whose outcomes are deterministic and which, being indistinguishable from the target to stochastic Pauli noise, fail at the same rate. We illustrate the protocol in Steane-code simulations of a magic state injection gadget and a quantum Fourier transform.

summaries.en: The paper presents a magic-free, code- and decoder-agnostic certification protocol for universal fault-tolerant quantum circuits that uses trap circuits with deterministically predictable outcomes to decide—at a fixed confidence—whether the logical error rate stays below a target threshold, with sample complexity scaling linearly in logical qubits and non-Clifford gates but not depending on the logical error rate, and demonstrates it via Steane-code simulations of magic-state injection and a quantum Fourier transform.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了一种无需消耗“魔术态”的认证协议，用于对通用容错量子电路进行逻辑错误率的可扩展检验：通过构造包含“魔术态被稳定子态替换”的陷阱电路，利用其在随机Pauli噪声下与目标电路不可区分且以相同速率失败的特性，在给定置信水平下判断器件的逻辑错误率是否低于预设阈值，且样本复杂度随逻辑比特数与非Clifford门数量线性增长而与逻辑错误率本身解耦，并在Steane码下的魔术态注入装置与量子傅里叶变换仿真中进行了验证。

title: Towards the Geometry of Quantum Optical Measurements: Kraus Trajectories in the Instrumental Weyl-Heisenberg Group Manifold
abstract: Since ancient Greek times, geometry has been a method by which humans can make inferences, by the use of similar triangles, about the world far beyond their immediate senses. Similarity plays an equally important role in quantum measurement, except that instead of triangles, the similarity is between the infinitesimal generators of rotation, canonical transformation, or some other virtual symmetry. For many quantum optical measurements of a single mode, these generators produce Kraus operators that are contained within a twelve-dimensional Lie group: the Instrumental Weyl-Heisenberg group manifold ($\mathrm{IWH}^{\textbf{12}}$). In particular, $\mathrm{IWH}^{\textbf{12}}$ is general enough to include all diffusively generated 'dyne measurements. In this paper, $\mathrm{IWH}^{\textbf{12}}$ will be used to develop two more general classes of 'dyne measurement: one that interpolates between diffusive homodyne and diffusive heterodyne (``slomodyne'') and one that adds to 'dyne measurements adaptive squeezing and displacement. Our analysis uses an approach known as the Instrument Manifold Program (IMP). In particular, a Harish-Chandra-like decomposition of $\mathrm{IWH}^{\textbf{12}}$ is used to calculate the vielbein transformation from a right-invariant basis to the corresponding coordinate basis, allowing us to universally and autonomously navigate $\mathrm{IWH}^{\textbf{12}}$ and locate the Kraus-operator of whatever selective process is being considered as it evolves in time according to the measurement record.

summaries.en: The paper develops a geometric Instrument Manifold Program framework using the 12-dimensional instrumental Weyl–Heisenberg (IWH^12) Lie group to track Kraus-operator trajectories for generalized dyne quantum optical measurements, including slomodyne interpolation between diffusive homodyne/heterodyne and dyne measurements with adaptive squeezing and displacement, via a Harish-Chandra-like decomposition that enables coordinate-vielbein transformations to autonomously locate evolving selective Kraus operators along measurement records.
summaries.zh: 论文基于12维工具魏尔–海森堡(IWH^12)李群提出“仪器流形计划”(IMP)的几何框架，通过Kraus算符轨迹刻画广义光学dyne测量，涵盖在弥散同调与弥散异调之间插值的slomodyne以及在dyne测量中加入自适应压缩与位移，并借助类似Harish-Chandra分解计算右不变基到坐标基的vielbein变换，从而在测量记录随时间演化时自主定位相应选择过程的Kraus算符。

title: Reverse quantum aging: Restoring rhythmicity from quantum aging state
abstract: Quantum aging transition has recently been reported, whereby the oscillatory dynamics of a network of globally coupled quantum self-sustained oscillators is degraded sharply when the fraction of inactive nodes exceeds a critical value. Here we explore the reverse process: the revival of rhythmic dynamics from an aged state in a quantum oscillator network by introducing a controlled incoherent single-boson pumping channel. Using a self-consistent quantum master equation in the Lindblad form for globally coupled active--inactive quantum Stuart--Landau oscillators, we show that increasing the pumping strength progressively suppresses the aging transition and eventually eliminates it, restoring rhythmicity even when all oscillators are inactive. Remarkably, complete compensation of the coupling-induced dissipative loss is not required; a substantially weaker pumping strength is sufficient to eliminate the aging transition. We show that the revival is governed by a redistribution of the Fock-state population of the inactive oscillators toward higher-occupation states. Our results establish controlled incoherent pumping as an effective mechanism for restoring dynamical robustness in quantum oscillator networks.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Adaptation and Self-Organizing Systems (nlin.AO); Chaotic Dynamics (nlin.CD); Applied Physics (physics.app-ph)

summaries.en: The paper shows that applying controlled incoherent single-boson pumping to a network of globally coupled quantum Stuart–Landau oscillators can reverse quantum aging by suppressing the aging transition, restoring rhythmic oscillations even when all nodes are inactive, due to a pumping-driven redistribution of inactive oscillators’ Fock-state populations to higher occupation states.
summaries.zh: 论文通过在全局耦合的量子斯图尔特–兰道振子网络中引入受控的非相干单玻色子泵浦，证明可逆转“量子老化”，即随泵浦强度增大抑制并最终消除老化转变，从而在所有振子都处于非激活状态时仍恢复有节奏的振荡，其机制来自泵浦引起的非激活振子的福克态占据向高占据态重新分配，并且不需要完全补偿耦合引起的耗散损失。

title: Geodesic steering for rapid dissipative entanglement distribution
abstract: We describe an optimal-control strategy designed to accelerate the dissipative preparation of complex, highly entangled quantum many-body states. Analogous to optimal steering of isolated quantum systems, our scheme identifies control pulses that guide the evolution of open quantum systems along trajectories of instantaneous steady states while minimizing leakage resulting from non-adiabatic transitions. In many cases of interest, these control parameters can be derived analytically and without the need for computationally expensive numerical simulations of the full many-body master equation. We apply this technique for the preparation of bi- and multipartite entangled states in qubit systems coupled to a common photonic waveguide or a distributed squeezed reservoir. In both scenarios, our optimal-control strategy significantly outperforms the bare relaxation dynamics after a quench, reducing preparation times of near-maximally entangled states by orders of magnitude. This drastic speedup makes dissipative entanglement distribution protocols compatible with high-fidelity quantum information processing applications and illustrates more broadly the potential of leakage minimization for accelerating reservoir-engineering schemes.

summaries.en: The paper proposes an optimal-control method that drives open quantum systems along instantaneous steady-state trajectories to rapidly generate highly entangled many-body states while minimizing non-adiabatic leakage, yielding analytically obtainable controls that drastically speed up dissipative entanglement preparation in qubits coupled to photonic waveguides or distributed squeezed reservoirs by orders of magnitude.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种最优控制方案，通过使开放量子系统沿即时稳态轨迹演化并最小化非绝热泄漏来快速制备高纠缠的多体量子态，且在许多情况下可解析得到控制参数而无需对完整多体主方程进行昂贵数值计算；在量子比特耦合公共光子波导或分布式压缩储量两类场景中，该方法相较猝冷后的单纯弛豫动力学显著提升性能，将接近最大纠缠态的制备时间缩短多个数量级，从而使耗散型纠缠分发协议更适配高保真量子信息处理并表明通过抑制泄漏可加速储量工程方案。

title: Photon-stimulated decay of $χ$-matched ancillas causes unheralded bit flips in bosonic codes
abstract: Bosonic codes often read out their syndrome with a transmon ancilla whose computational levels $g$ and $f$ have equal parity and matched dispersive shifts: a decay $f\to e$ is then heralded and leaves the code intact, while the direct $f\to g$ is forbidden by parity. We show that the photons of the code open this decay at first order in the ancilla's decay rate. Dressing by the code mode lets the charge noise that limits the ancilla's $T_1$ drive a photon-stimulated Raman decay $|f,n\rangle\to|g,n+1\rangle$, at $(n+1)(\chi_{ge}/2g_{01})^2$ times the $f\to e$ rate for a smooth noise spectrum. When the matching is set by the detuning, the decay costs $\approx\Gamma_{fe}/\alpha$ per gate and photon, whatever the coupling strength; a deliberate mismatch or matching by a drive lowers this cost, and a qubit ancilla has no such channel. The opened decay is unheralded and flips a cat with probability $\approx 1/2$; being first order, it overtakes the second-order double decay $f\to e\to g$ as the ancilla improves. In a microscopic model of the Ocelot repetition cat code, it makes the bit-flip floor of the gates grow linearly with the cat size, by a factor 1.2-1.7 from four to ten photons, which would limit the noise bias to $\sim 10^3$. The published gate data end at four photons and do not yet test this growth.

summaries.en: The paper shows that code photons can activate a first-order photon-stimulated Raman decay of a χ-matched transmon ancilla, producing unheralded bit flips in bosonic (cat) codes at a rate scaling with photon number and ultimately limiting noise bias as cat size increases.
summaries.zh: 论文指出，χ匹配的跨门（transmon）辅助比特在玻色型（猫态）码中会被码光子在一阶作用下“打开”一种光子刺激的拉曼衰变通道，从而造成无法预警的比特翻转，并且翻转概率随猫态光子数增长，进而限制噪声偏置。

title: Architecting Instruction Execution for Scalable Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computing
abstract: Scaling fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC) requires orchestrating millions of operations continuously across a tightly coupled classical-quantum control stack. A critical challenge in this orchestration is determining the optimal hardware-software boundary, i.e., the Quantum Instruction Set Architecture (QISA). We focus on cryogenic, fixed-connectivity qubit platforms, such as superconducting and topological Majorana qubits. For these, existing QISA choices either operate at too low a level, violating cryogenic thermal budgets at scale, or at too high a level, imposing unrealizable complexity on the control engine. To reason about these tradeoffs, we introduce the ARIES instruction set hierarchy, which categorizes QISAs into distinct abstraction levels. To systematically evaluate these levels, we develop an end-to-end evaluation toolflow featuring a cycle-accurate classical driver and hardware engine simulator. Using eight quantum applications across superconducting and topological qubit platforms, we measure instruction bandwidth, transceiver power dissipation, and measurement processing overheads. We demonstrate that while physical-level abstractions exceed the thermal limits of dilution refrigerators by orders of magnitude, canonical-level abstractions significantly underestimate hardware routing congestion and execution runtimes. Our Level 4 QISA (local logical operations) offers an optimal architectural balance. As quantum hardware platforms scale toward FTQC in the coming years, our findings provide concrete architectural guidance for the design of their classical control stacks and instruction interfaces.

summaries.en: The paper proposes the ARIES QISA hierarchy and an end-to-end simulation and evaluation toolflow to benchmark instruction-set abstraction levels for cryogenic fixed-connectivity qubit platforms, showing that Level 4 (local logical operations) best balances thermal feasibility against routing congestion and execution runtime for scalable fault-tolerant quantum computing.
summaries.zh: 论文提出ARIES量子指令集架构（QISA）层次体系及端到端仿真评估工具链，用于在低温固定连接的量子平台上对不同指令抽象层级进行对比，结果表明第4层（局部逻辑操作）在热预算可行性与路由拥塞、执行时延之间取得最佳折中，从而为可扩展容错量子计算的经典控制栈与指令接口设计提供依据。

title: Bosonic unstructured search: quantum enhancement without entanglement
abstract: We consider unstructured search using multimode bosonic quantum systems under energy constraints. The task is to locate an unknown marked mode among $N$ possibilities using arbitrary control, subject to a time-averaged mean-boson-number budget $n_{\text{b}}\gg 1$. We analyze a continuous-time phase-shift oracle of strength $B_{0}$, with cost given by the total oracle time, and a discrete oracle with fixed phase $\phi_{0}$, with cost given by the number of queries. We give algorithms that identify the target with query complexity $O(\sqrt{N}/{n_{\text{b}}}B_{0})$ for continuous-time oracles or $O(\sqrt{N}/n_{\text{b}} |{\sin(\phi_{0}/{2})}|)$ for discrete oracles with $n_{\text{b}} |{\sin(\phi_{0}/{2})}|=O(1)$. In contrast, for discrete oracles with $n_{\text{b}} |{\sin(\phi_{0}/{2})}|=\Omega(1)$, we provide an algorithm using $O(\max\{1,\sqrt{N/n_{\text{b}}|{\sin(\phi_{0}/{2})}|}\})$ queries. We also prove matching lower bounds on the query complexity, showing that these algorithms are asymptotically optimal. Furthermore, we show that, in the absence of loss, non-Gaussianity is necessary to achieve the optimal joint query scaling in $N$ and $n_{\text{b}}$, but entanglement is not. Under uniform boson loss at rate $\gamma$, we prove a query lower bound of $\Omega ( \gamma N / n _{\text{b}} B_{0}^{2} )$, attained for $\gamma = \Omega(B_{0} \sqrt{n _{\text{b}}/N})$ using coherent-state probes. Finally, we propose experimental implementations using multipass optical microscopy or superconducting circuits as potential routes to speeding up imaging or device calibration with a low boson-number budget.

summaries.en: The paper analyzes unstructured search over N modes using multimode bosonic systems with a mean-boson-number budget n_b, deriving energy-constrained query complexities for continuous-time and discrete phase-shift oracles, proving matching lower bounds and showing that entanglement is not required for optimal scaling (while non-Gaussianity is), quantifying loss-limited performance, and outlining optical microscopy or superconducting-circuit implementations for faster imaging or calibration under low photon budgets.
summaries.zh: 论文在给定平均玻色子数预算 n_b 的约束下研究在 N 个模式中进行无结构搜索的问题，分别推导连续时间与离散相位移预言机的能量受限查询复杂度并给出相应的渐近下界，证明最优联合缩放不需要纠缠但需要非高斯性，进一步刻画有损情况下的下界并讨论在低光子/玻色子预算下可通过多次通过光学显微成像或超导电路实现加速成像与器件标定的实验方案。

title: Ghost unitaries for loss-resilient photonic resource-state generation
abstract: Entangled few-photon states, such as Bell and Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ) states, are central resources for discrete-variable photonic quantum information processing. In many architectures, these states are generated probabilistically by first heralding single photons from biphoton sources and then interfering them in linear-optical circuits. In this work, we show that the entanglement structure of said biphoton sources can be directly exploited for noise-engineering to deliver higher quality resource states. Using the transpose identity of multi-mode squeezed vacuum states, we introduce "ghost-unitary" implementations in which the target resource-generation interferometer is applied to the heralding modes rather than to the delivered resource modes. When the dominant imperfection is interferometric loss, this relocation converts direct amplitude damping of the output into false-positive heralding events that require both higher-pair emission and photon loss. In the low-squeezing regime, these events are parametrically suppressed, yielding higher-fidelity conditional resource states. We analyze this mechanism for single-qubit states, two-photon NOON states, Bell states, and a family of $n$-qubit GHZ states, as well as for single-qubit teleportation and type-I-fusion-based resource growth. Across these examples, we delineate finite parameter regimes in which ghost-unitary implementations outperform direct implementations, with particular relevance to frequency-bin photonics where active linear-optical transformations can be relatively lossy. We also prove that, in the setting considered here, the direct implementation of the $n$-GHZ family delivers identically damped outputs: equivalent to the ideal state followed by uniform amplitude damping. This extends the known $n=2,3$ cases and provides a structural result of independent interest for photonic quantum information processing.

summaries.en: The paper proposes “ghost-unitary” interferometer implementations that apply the target entanglement circuit to heralding modes of biphoton sources rather than delivered modes, transforming loss into parametrically suppressed false-positive heralding events and thereby producing higher-fidelity photonic resource states (including NOON, Bell, and n-GHZ states and related protocols) in regimes relevant to lossy frequency-bin photonics while proving that direct n-GHZ implementations yield outputs equivalent to ideal states followed by uniform amplitude damping.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出“幽灵幺正”(ghost-unitary)实现：将用于制备目标纠缠的干涉器件应用在双光子源的表征(heralding)模上而非传递资源的模上，从而在主要误差为干涉损耗时把损耗转化为在参数上被抑制的假阳性表征事件并提升贝尔、NOON 以及 n-GHZ 等光子资源态（以及相关传输/资源增长协议）的保真度；同时作者证明在所研究的设置中，直接 n-GHZ 实现会得到等价于“理想态后接均匀幅度阻尼”的输出，并指出该方法在相对易损的频率梳(bin)光子学场景尤具优势。

title: Krylov Complexity and Quantum Many-body Scars in Non-Hermitian Kinetically Constrained Models
abstract: Thermalization in closed quantum systems and its breakdown are central to understanding the emergence of statistical behavior in isolated many-body systems. Kinetic constraints can hinder thermalization by restricting the allowed dynamics and giving rise to non-ergodic behavior. While various aspects of ergodicity breaking in kinetically constrained models have been extensively studied in Hermitian systems, their behavior in non-Hermitian kinetically constrained models remains less explored. In particular, the inequivalence of left and right eigenstate ensembles in non-Hermitian systems raises the question of whether they exhibit qualitatively different dynamical and eigenstate properties. In this work, we study non-Hermitian generalizations of the paradigmatic PXP and PPXPP models, focusing on their Krylov complexity, eigenstate structure, and dynamics. By exploiting the Arnoldi's algorithm, we find distinct behavior of Krylov complexity in the left and right eigenstate ensembles as non-Hermiticity is increased: in the right ensemble, it exhibits persistent oscillations with an increasing period, while in the left ensemble, it gradually saturates. The characteristic arch-shaped profile of the Arnoldi coefficients is also modified differently in the two ensembles, with a Hermitian-like arch re-emerging in the left ensemble at large non Hermiticity. Additionally, in the non-Hermitian PXP model, the right ensemble retains the characteristic scar structure, while the left ensemble develops additional non-scar eigenstates with anomalously low entanglement and large overlap with the vacuum state. These findings reveal that non-Hermiticity can affect Krylov dynamics and eigenstate structure differently in the left and right ensembles, demonstrating the need to treat them separately when characterizing non-Hermitian kinetically constrained systems.

summaries.en: The paper studies non-Hermitian extensions of PXP/PPXPP kinetic constraints and finds that, as non-Hermiticity increases, Krylov complexity, Arnoldi-coefficient profiles, and scar/eigenstate properties differ qualitatively between right and left eigenstate ensembles—right ensembles show persistent oscillatory complexity and retain scar structures in the PXP case, while left ensembles show saturation, modified arch profiles, and emergence of additional low-entanglement non-scar states with strong vacuum overlap.
summaries.zh: 论文研究了非厄米动力学约束模型PXP/PPXPP的推广，发现随着非厄米性增强，Krylov复杂度、Arnoldi系数的拱形轮廓以及壳层（scar）/本征态性质在右与左本征态系综之间出现显著不同：右系综表现为持续振荡的复杂度并在PXP情形中保持scar结构，而左系综则逐步饱和、拱形轮廓被改变，并出现额外的低纠缠非scar本征态且与真空态具有强重叠。

title: Periodic-Pulse Control of Collective Emission and Photon Statistics in Interacting Quantum Emitters
abstract: We investigate the collective emission spectra and photon correlations of two identical dipole-dipole-coupled emitters under continuous-wave (CW) and periodic pulsed driving. Our results show that a periodic train of instantaneous $\pi_x$ pulses can generate emission spectra whose dominant features closely resemble those obtained under CW excitation. We find that the structure of the collective emission spectra reflects the interplay among the resonance conditions, dipole-dipole coupling, and the inter-pulse delay $\tau_D$. We further demonstrate that finite-duration $\pi_x$ pulses with sufficiently high Rabi frequencies can closely reproduce the ideal instantaneous-pulse limit. In contrast to the emission spectra, the photon correlations $g^{(2)}(t,\tau)$ are governed primarily by $\tau_D$ and, unlike under CW driving, become increasingly insensitive to the resonance conditions in the short-pulse limit. These results establish periodic pulsed driving as a versatile means of tailoring both the emission spectra and the photon statistics of coupled two-emitter systems.

summaries.en: The paper studies how continuous-wave versus periodic pulsed (including ideal and finite-duration π_x) driving affects collective emission spectra and photon correlations of two interacting dipole-coupled quantum emitters, finding that periodic π-pulse trains can reproduce CW-like spectral features while g^(2)(t,τ) behavior is mainly controlled by the inter-pulse delay and becomes less sensitive to resonance in the short-pulse regime.
summaries.zh: 本文比较了两相互作用偶极-偶极耦合量子发射体在连续波与周期性脉冲（理想及有限时长π_x）驱动下的集体辐射谱和光子关联，发现周期性π脉冲列能产生与连续波高度相似的谱特征，而g^(2)(t,τ)的行为主要由脉冲间隔τ_D决定，并在短脉冲极限下对共振条件的敏感性降低。

title: Distributed quantum phase sensing using an SU(1,1) Perelomov coherent state in a Mach-Zehnder interferometer network
abstract: We present a theoretical study of distributed quantum sensing using a reconfigurable network of $N$ Mach--Zehnder interferometers to simultaneously estimate weighted linear combinations of relative phase shifts. The proposed scheme relies on injecting a Perelomov coherent state, generated from the SU(1,1) group representation, into one port of a passive quantum circuit while the remaining modes are initialized in the vacuum state, thereby establishing non-trivial quantum correlations among the sensors. Based on multi-parameter quantum estimation theory, our analysis shows that this entangled strategy outperforms the standard shot-noise limit and asymptotically achieves the Heisenberg limit. Furthermore, we highlight the crucial role of the first beam splitter's asymmetry; specifically, the optimal transmission coefficient that maximizes sensitivity corresponds to its maximum imbalance. Compared to a separable approach utilizing the same total average photon number, the entangled strategy yields a more efficient use of quantum resources, guaranteeing an accuracy gain between $1$ and $N$. This demonstrates that the entangled strategy is systematically superior to its separable counterpart. Ultimately, these results illustrate the potential of entangled distributed quantum sensor networks for high-precision measurements and provide clear guidelines for optimizing interferometric architectures in quantum metrology.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a distributed quantum phase-sensing scheme using a reconfigurable network of Mach–Zehnder interferometers fed with an SU(1,1) Perelomov coherent state to estimate weighted sums of relative phase shifts, showing via multi-parameter quantum estimation that the resulting entangled strategy beats the shot-noise limit, reaches the Heisenberg limit asymptotically, and is optimized by maximizing the first beam splitter’s asymmetry, outperforming separable sensing with the same photon budget by an accuracy gain scaling between 1 and N.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了一种基于可重构马赫-曾德尔干涉仪网络的分布式量子相位测量方案：将由SU(1,1)表示生成的Perelomov相干态注入被动量子电路的一端口，其余端口置真空以建立传感器间纠缠；借助多参数量子估计理论表明该纠缠策略超越散粒噪声极限并在渐近上达到海森堡极限，且灵敏度最优对应于第一束分器的最大不对称性（传输系数取最大失配），与在相同平均光子数下的可分离方案相比，其精度提升可在1到N之间量级，体现纠缠分布式量子传感网络在高精度测量中的系统优势，并给出量子计量中干涉架构优化的明确准则。

title: Chromatic Block-Gibbs p-Bit Decoding of QLDPC Codes
abstract: We introduce a parallel decoder for quantum low-density parity-check (QLDPC) codes based on probabilistic bits (p-bits), tunable stochastic binary units controlled by local fields. The idea is that predicted error configurations, interpreted as explanations of the observed syndrome, are updated stochastically using local Gibbs conditionals, while a progressively strengthened parity penalty drives the search toward syndrome-valid configurations. A coloring of the decoding graph enables parallel block updates, and independent replicas and restarts provide trajectory diversity. The best candidate encountered during the search is returned, mirroring the candidate-selection strategy of recent ensemble decoders. At the stated update budgets, the resulting logical error rates are on par with leading decoders under both code-capacity and circuit-level noise. While the total number of variable resamplings can be substantially larger than the message-update count of BP-based alternatives, the numerical results establish constraint-annealed p-bit dynamics as a competitive stochastic alternative for QLDPC decoding and motivate further study of hardware-native implementations.

summaries.en: The paper presents a parallel p-bit (stochastic binary unit) Gibbs-based decoder for QLDPC codes that uses progressively strengthened parity penalties, graph coloring for block updates, and replica restarts to diversify stochastic trajectories, achieving logical error rates comparable to leading decoders under both code-capacity and circuit-level noise despite higher variable resampling budgets.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种基于p-bit（受局部场调控的随机二值单元）与Gibbs条件的QLDPC并行译码器：通过逐步增强的奇偶惩罚来收敛到满足综合的误差配置，借助解码图的着色实现分块并行更新，并使用多副本与重启提升随机搜索轨迹多样性，在代码容量噪声与电路级噪声下逻辑错误率可与领先译码器相当，尽管所需变量重采样次数可能显著高于BP类方法。

title: Coherent optical control of a thousand qubits in a three-dimensional trapped-ion crystal
abstract: Leading quantum platforms are largely limited to one or two dimensions, whereas three-dimensional Coulomb crystals of trapped ions self-assemble into dense qubit arrays with no rearrangement overhead. Coherent optical control of such crystals has nonetheless been out of reach, because the optical transition couples to nearly all $3N$ collective modes, i.e., a thermally occupied quasi-continuum bath. Here we cool about 3,600 modes of a crystal of over 1,200 ions below single-phonon occupation, using a continuous cooling band that spans more than five octaves in vibrational spectrum, from about 50 kHz to 2.1 MHz. The crystal then serves as a register of optical qubits, allowing global initialization, coherent manipulation and collective detection. We demonstrate ensemble optical coherence of 21.6 milliseconds and reduce the optical-transition frequency uncertainty from 389 Hz for a single ion to 12 Hz for over a thousand ions, approaching the expected projection-noise scaling. Our approach could be extended to even larger crystals with phonon-mediated many-body couplings, opening a route towards entanglement-enhanced precision metrology and three-dimensional quantum simulation, particularly with spatial-shaped illumination for region-resolved collective control.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates coherent optical control of a three-dimensional trapped-ion Coulomb crystal by cooling about 3,600 collective vibrational modes below single-phonon occupation, enabling global initialization, coherent manipulation, and collective detection of optical qubits across over 1,200 ions with long ensemble coherence and greatly reduced optical-frequency uncertainty approaching projection-noise scaling.
summaries.zh: 论文通过将约3600个三维俘获离子库仑晶体的集体振动模冷却到单声子以下，实现对超过1200个离子光学量子比特的相干光学控制，从而完成全局初始化、相干操作与集体探测，并在保持较长集体相干时间的同时将光学跃迁频率不确定度显著降低至接近投影噪声标度，为三维量子模拟和纠缠增强精密测量铺路。

title: From Syndromes to Computation: A General Framework for Logical Operations in Quantum Error-Correcting Codes
abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computation requires error-correcting codes that not only protect quantum information but also support useful logical operations with practical physical realizations. Here we develop a general framework in which the stabilizer syndromes of commuting Pauli rotations directly organize logical-gate design. We derive an exact codespace-preservation condition valid at arbitrary rotation angles, providing a common stabilizer-level description for CSS and non-CSS codes and for both Clifford and non-Clifford operations. A particularly useful equal-syndrome specialization reduces Clifford gate design to stabilizer factorization, yields a general generator weight bound of $\lceil d/2\rceil$ for distance-$d$ codes, and systematically extends to logical rotations higher in the Clifford hierarchy. Applied to bivariate-bicycle (BB) and non-CSS Mirror qLDPC codes, the framework gives explicit low-weight Clifford and controlled-phase gates. Our implementations yield new low-weight gates, including an addressed $T$ gate on the $[[16,4,4]]$ BB code, $T$-type rotations on the $[[64,8,8]]$ BB code, and CCZ-, CS-, and $T$-type operations on the $[[36,6,6]]$ Mirror code. We also develop analytic constructions using Clifford algebra bases, which turn the syndrome constraints into explicit algebraic relations and provide a systematic route to logical addressability. We use this approach to analytically construct addressed CNOT, SWAP, controlled, and CCZ-type gates on recursive hypercube codes. An independent construction on middle quantum Reed--Muller codes yields C${}^r$Z gates that saturate the equal-syndrome weight bound. These results establish stabilizer syndromes as a constructive link between the stabilizer structure of a quantum code, the logical computations it can directly support, and the fault-tolerance properties of their physical realizations.

summaries.en: The paper presents a general stabilizer-syndrome framework that converts commuting-Pauli measurement outcomes into logical gate constructions, deriving exact codespace-preservation conditions for arbitrary rotation angles across CSS and non-CSS codes and Clifford and non-Clifford operations, then uses it to build explicit low-weight logical gates and analytic algebraic constructions for several code families and addressable multi-qubit operations.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种通用的稳定器-综合测量框架：利用可交换保利旋转的稳定器综合来直接组织逻辑门设计，并在任意旋转角下推导出精确的码空间保持条件，适用于CSS与非CSS码以及Clifford与非Clifford操作；作者进一步在多个码族中给出显式低权重逻辑门及将综合约束转化为代数关系的解析构造，从而实现可寻址的多体门并展示其容错实现价值。

title: Toward Interpretable Quantum Generators for Financial Returns through Problem-Informed Circuit Design
abstract: When used as function approximators, quantum circuits often lack interpretability and face a fundamental trade-off between expressivity and trainability. We propose a problem-informed framework for financial return generation that uses relational structure and symmetry-inspired parameter sharing to guide the construction of quantum circuits with few trainable parameters and empirically testable operator roles. We evaluate three quantum generator architectures, referred to as ZZ, directed ZZ-CRX, and structured time evolution, within a hybrid Wasserstein quantum generative adversarial network trained to generate 16-step Bitcoin return windows. Across circuits with one to four layers and one to eight trainable coefficients, these generators recover meaningful marginal and temporal distributional features, while single-layer configurations remain competitive with deeper variants. Across matched depths, independently trained ZZ-CRX configurations exhibit a predominantly downward shift in median leverage relative to ZZ, consistent with the intended directional role of the controlled-rotation construction. The small number of coefficients also enables direct landscape analysis, revealing competing parameter preferences between marginal and temporal objectives and helping to explain the difficulty of finding parameter settings that perform well on both. These results provide an initial demonstration that structural assumptions can guide the design of compact quantum generators and link circuit architecture to observable statistical behaviour, motivating more systematic and parameter-efficient approaches to quantum circuit construction.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a problem-informed, symmetry- and structure-guided method to design interpretable, parameter-efficient quantum circuits for generating Bitcoin return windows within a hybrid Wasserstein quantum GAN, showing that architectures like ZZ, directed ZZ-CRX, and structured time evolution recover key marginal and temporal distribution features with as few as 1–8 trainable coefficients and that landscape analysis reveals why optimizing both marginal and temporal objectives can be difficult.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种基于问题的信息驱动框架，通过对称性启发的参数共享与关系结构引导设计紧凑且可解释、可训练参数很少的量子电路，用于在混合式 Wasserstein 量子生成对抗网络中生成 16 步比特币收益窗口；结果表明在 1–4 层、仅 1–8 个可训练系数的情况下，ZZ、定向 ZZ-CRX 和结构化时间演化等架构都能恢复关键的边际与时间分布特征，且对参数地形的分析揭示了同时兼顾边际与时间目标为何会困难，同时也能将电路结构与可观测统计行为联系起来。

title: Boson Sampling Using Fock States from On-Demand Single Photon Source Arrays: Quantum Complexity & Impact of Dephasing
abstract: Boson sampling with array of on-demand single photons (discreet variable Fock states) as resource states provides distinct advantages in complexity scaling compared to single photon resource states mimicked by the states (continuous variable) generated in nonlinear photonics. Recent progress in realization of regular ordered array of mesa top single quantum dots (MTSQDs) enabling on-demand generation of many photon resource states with high single photon purity and indistinguishability [1,2] has opened the possibility of implementing chip-scale Boson sampling with single photons. An important question towards scale up of such circuits is how the dephasing and decay timescale of individual on-demand single photons affect the final probability distribution of the N-photon entangled state. In this work we report a framework that provides direct link between the physical sources of decoherence to the outcome of multiphoton correlation measurements. We explicitly incorporate the symmetrization of the N-photon states while accounting for the shape of the individual wave packets and dephasing. Using this framework, we show predictive estimates of the probability of generation of a 4-photon NOON state using an optical circuit initialized with 4 identical single photon wave packets, mimicking the emitted photons from MTSQD single photon sources reported in [2]. Specifically, we show how the probability of generating various 4-photon entangled states depend on the two-photon interference visibility which is determined by the pure dephasing timescale in relation to the radiative decay timescale. The results provide quantitative guidelines to measure 4 photon and higher number of entangled photon states generated in an optical circuit with on demand single photon sources and provide a link between physical processes such as temperature and the output state of the quantum optical circuits.

summaries.en: The paper develops a framework connecting single-photon dephasing and decay mechanisms in on-demand single-photon source arrays to multiphoton correlation outcomes, using it to predict how 4-photon entangled-state generation (including NOON states) depends on the two-photon interference visibility set by the dephasing-to-radiative-decay timescale.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出一个框架，将按需单光子阵列中单光子的去相干与衰减物理机制直接关联到多光子相关测量结果，并据此预测：在以形状相同的四个单光子波包初始化的光学电路中，四光子纠缠态（含NOON态）的生成概率如何取决于由去相干时间尺度相对辐射衰减时间尺度决定的二光子干涉可见度。

title: Broadening the reflection band of atomic mirrors by engineering the emitter-waveguide coupling
abstract: We theoretically investigate single-photon coherent transport through a finite waveguide quantum electrodynamics (QED) array with spatially modulated emitter-waveguide couplings. By combining exact scattering calculations with spectral factorization and a semiclassical WKB analysis, we identify how the coupling profile controls the reflection bandwidth and its finite-size dependence. A Gaussian transverse displacement produces an exponential-of-Gaussian decay-rate profile that broadens the high-reflectivity window and suppresses the boundary-induced Fabry-Perot oscillations compared with a uniform array. The transmission zeros remain exactly degenerate at the atomic resonance for arbitrary positive coupling profiles at non-Bragg spacings. In contrast, the collective poles reorganize under the spatial modulation, redistributing their radiative widths and preventing individual subradiant resonances from terminating the reflection window. We further derive an algebraic 1/N scaling law for the contraction of the bandwidth toward its bulk value. The bulk bandwidth is determined by the largest local decay rate, whereas the finite-size correction increases as the profile becomes sharper, leading to an optimal profile width. These results establish spatial coupling engineering as a practical tool for designing broadband atomic mirrors in atom-nanofiber and circuit-QED platforms.

summaries.en: The paper shows that spatially engineered emitter–waveguide couplings in a finite waveguide QED array can broaden and stabilize the reflection band of atomic mirrors by shaping decay-rate profiles, preserving degenerate transmission zeros at resonance, and reorganizing collective pole structures to prevent subradiant resonances from ending high reflectivity, with finite-size bandwidth corrections following an algebraic 1/N law tied to the largest local decay rate and an optimal coupling-width.
summaries.zh: 论文通过在有限波导QED阵列中对发射体—波导耦合进行空间工程，表明可利用耦合调制来塑造衰减率从而展宽并稳定原子镜的反射带宽：在任意非布拉格间距下仍保持共振处传输零点严格简并，同时空间调制会重组集体极结构，避免亚辐射共振终止高反射窗口，并给出带宽向本征（无限尺寸）值收缩的代数1/N有限尺寸修正规律，该修正由最大局域衰减率决定且随耦合轮廓变尖而增大，从而产生最佳轮廓宽度，证明该方法可用于原子-纳米光纤与电路QED平台设计宽带原子镜。

title: Scalable long-distance quantum fan-out gates with reduced resource overhead
abstract: Scalable long-distance quantum gates are essential for distributed quantum computation and scalable quantum networks. We propose an efficient scheme for implementing an $n$-qubit fan-out gate $C^n$ (also known as a controlled-NOT-$\cdots$-NOT gate) across spatially separated parties. Our protocol requires only a pre-shared $n$-qubit Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger state, $n$ local controlled-NOT (CNOT) gates, and feed-forward operations, thereby reducing both the CNOT and Hadamard gate counts by $(n-2)$ when compared with the standard decomposition-based approach. We further develop two optical architectures to implement the heralded and post-selected $n$-photon fan-out gates, respectively. These schemes require fewer single photons resources and achieve higher success probabilities than their decomposition-based counterparts, representing significant improvements. The results indicate that our approach is experimentally feasible and pave the way toward practical long-distance quantum computation.

summaries.en: The paper presents an efficient protocol for implementing an n-qubit long-distance controlled fan-out (controlled-NOT-…-NOT) gate using only a pre-shared n-qubit GHZ state, n local CNOTs, and feed-forward, reducing CNOT and Hadamard overhead versus standard methods, and proposes two optical architectures for heralded and post-selected n-photon versions with higher success probabilities and lower single-photon resource needs, demonstrating experimental feasibility for practical distributed quantum computation.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了一种高效的长距离空间分布 n 比特受控扇出（连续受控非门）n 比特门实现方案，只需预共享 n 比特 GHZ 态、n 个本地 CNOT 门和前馈操作，就能相较于基于分解的常规方法将 CNOT 与 Hadamard 门开销各减少（n-2），并进一步给出两种用于实现该 n 光子扇出的光学架构（告警与后选），其所需单光子资源更少且成功概率更高，从而表明该方案具有实验可行性并推动实际长距离量子计算的发展。

title: Theory of Trotter Error with Variable-Weight Schedules
abstract: Trotterization is a widely used algorithm for simulating quantum evolutions and consists of approximating a target unitary through a local linear decomposition of its generator that is repeated over $N$ steps. We introduce {scheduled trotterization}, a variable-weight modification in which the coefficients of the local linear decomposition are allowed to change from step to step.
