Using the geometry of the Lie group of unitary operators, we express the global endpoint error as a product of transported local defects, whose leading terms are obtained by two applications of the Baker-Campbell-Hausdorff formula, one inside each local step and one between different transported defects, separating the internal Trotter error from the external accumulation error. While we recover recent tighter bounds on the global approximation error when the weights are held fixed, the new framework allows us to propose a weight-varying schedule that significantly decreases the global error. For exact infinitesimal synthesis, we prove that this improves the usual fixed-weight $O(N^{-1})$ behavior to $O(N^{-2})$, without changing the basic pulse skeleton. We also extend the framework to imperfect infinitesimal synthesis, as arises in quantum gate synthesis problems, where admissible coefficients may only approximate the desired local corrections. In this case, the error is controlled by a local covering parameter measuring the quality of the available coefficient set. Numerical experiments for random $\SU(2)$ targets further support the predicted theoretical improvements. The results suggest a novel perspective for the analysis of Trotter errors, which can be treated as schedulable quantities to be coherently canceled at the endpoint.

summaries.en: The paper develops a geometry-based framework for “scheduled trotterization,” where variable step-dependent weights in a Lie-algebraic decomposition enable separating and controlling internal versus accumulated Trotter errors, yielding improved global approximation scaling (including O(N^{-2}) for exact infinitesimal synthesis) and supporting robust extensions to imperfect synthesis via a local covering parameter, confirmed by numerical simulations on random SU(2) targets.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种基于李群几何的“调度式”Trotter 化框架，通过允许每一步的权重按需变化来区分并控制内部Trotter误差与其在端点处的外部累积误差，进而在精确的无限小合成中将全局近似误差从常见的 O(N^{-1}) 改善到 O(N^{-2})，并将该框架扩展到系数不完美可用的情形（用局部覆盖参数度量可选系数的质量）且通过对随机SU(2)目标的数值实验验证了理论改进，体现出可将Trotter误差视作可调度量以在端点相干抵消的新分析视角。

title: Experimental Benchmarking of a 256-Qubit Room-Temperature NV-Diamond Quantum Processor with an Optically Programmable Biomolecular Quantum Bus
abstract: We report Zeus-256, a room-temperature nitrogen-vacancy (NV) diamond processor with 256 simultaneously active processor-level logical qubits arranged in a 16 x 16 array. Each logical qubit combines an NV electron-spin ensemble with nuclear-spin memory and ancillary resources. OpenQASM 2.0 circuits are transpiled into RFSoC-controlled microwave, radio-frequency, optical, timing, measurement and bus-configuration sequences. An optically programmable proprietary protein-chromophore layer with an internal metastable-triplet spin mediator provides a reconfigurable biomolecular quantum bus for local and long-range interactions. Benchmarks cover QFT, GHZ entanglement, Grover search, arithmetic, variational, neural-network, graph-state and Shor-family circuits. Factor recovery is reported for 11 integers of 8-84 bits, with 10 attempts per instance; the 84-bit endpoint uses 256 qubits and 40,250,342 reported gates, with a reported execution time of 551.694 ms. Bell-CHSH measurements yield S = 2.8008 +/- 0.0446. Three-qubit Grover search returns the marked state in 958 of 1,024 shots (93.55%), compared with an ideal reference of 94.53%. A separate 30,000-shot population-and-parity protocol yields fixed-phase GHZ+ fidelity of 99.8960%, an estimated standard error of 0.2885 percentage points and a conservative physical 95% interval of [98.2342%, 100%]. Timing metrics are partial and do not establish quantum advantage. Scaling to 9,984 processor-level logical qubits is an engineering target, distinct from the demonstrated register.

summaries.en: The paper reports Zeus-256, a room-temperature 256-qubit NV-diamond processor with OpenQASM-to-RFSoC control and an optically programmable biomolecular quantum bus, and presents experimental benchmarks including QFT/entanglement/search/variational/graph-state circuits, 11 integer factor recoveries up to an 84-bit instance in 551.
summaries.zh: 论文报道了室温下的Zeus-256 NV金刚石量子处理器，其包含由OpenQASM到RFSoC控制并结合可光编程的生物分子量子总线实现的256个处理器级逻辑量子比特，并给出涵盖QFT/纠缠/搜索/变分/图态等电路的实验基准结果，包括最大84比特的11个整数分解（耗时551.

title: A complete quantum process model for physically realistic photo-detection in the joint photon-number and spectral degrees of freedom
abstract: Photo-detection is a fundamental component of experimental photonics, yet theoretical models often treat detectors solely in the photon-number basis, neglecting other relevant degrees of freedom such as spectral characteristics. We present a complete quantum process model for physically realistic photodetection that incorporates both photon-number effects and frequency-dependent detector response, described through explicitly derived Kraus operators in the operator-sum representation. This formalism accommodates realistic inefficiencies, models detection within finite spectral windows, and can be directly substituted for idealized models in quantum optical analyses. The model leads to identifying the suitable detection window of the detectors relative to the spectral distribution of incident photons and conversely, in order to maximize the observability of quantum effects.

summaries.en: The paper develops a physically realistic quantum-process (Kraus-operator) model of photodetection that jointly accounts for photon-number and frequency-dependent detector response, enabling finite spectral-window detection, realistic inefficiencies, and guidance on choosing detector windows to maximize the observability of quantum effects.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了一种基于Kraus算符的物理真实量子过程模型，用于同时刻画光电探测中的光子数与与频率相关的探测器响应，从而实现有限光谱窗口检测、纳入真实效率损失，并指导探测窗口与入射光谱分布的匹配以最大化量子效应的可观测性。

title: Experimental Realization of a C-Shunt Flux-Qubit Coupler for Controlled-Z Gates between Transmons
abstract: Fast entangling gates and low-interaction idling require distinct operating conditions in superconducting quantum processors. We experimentally realize a transmon-C-shunt-transmon (TCT) device in which a flux-tunable, three-junction capacitively shunted flux-qubit coupler connects two transmon data qubits. The C-shunt coupler provides a flux-tunable, positively anharmonic spectrum for tailoring the interactions between the data qubits. Conditional Ramsey and swap measurements identify an idle region with near-zero residual ZZ interaction strength and suppressed transverse exchange. At this bias, simultaneous single-qubit interleaved randomized benchmarking yields X-gate fldelities above 99.7%, consistent with individual operation. A 45 ns nonadiabatic controlled-Z (CZ) gate achieves an interleaved randomized benchmarking fldelity estimate of 99.23(15)%. Numerical simulations identify coupler energy relaxation as an important limitation on CZ-gate fldelity and indicate that extending the coupler lifetime can improve gate performance. These results demonstrate the experimental feasibility of C-shunt flux-qubit couplers for combining low-interaction idling with fast entangling operations between transmon qubits.

summaries.en: The paper experimentally demonstrates a flux-tunable three-junction C-shunt flux-qubit coupler that connects two transmon qubits, enabling an idle point with near-zero residual ZZ interaction, over 99.
summaries.zh: 本文实验实现了一种由通量可调的三约瑟夫森C型分容（C-shunt）通量量子比特耦合器连接两个transmon量子比特的装置，在偏置点实现近零残余ZZ相互作用、单比特X门保真度超过99.

title: Lifting: Quantum State Discrimination Framework for Mid-Circuit Measurements
abstract: Quantum computing promises new capabilities beyond classical computation. Mid-circuit measurements (MCMs) enable error correction and outcome-dependent control, but their reliability is limited by noise on superconducting hardware. These operations depend on accurate quantum state discrimination (QSD), which assigns measured signals to state labels. Neural network-based (NN-based) QSD improves this assignment, yet its error remains bounded below by the Bayes risk of the available readout distributions. A complementary challenge is state deterioration as successive measurements accumulate and circuit execution advances, making static calibration less representative of the workload. We present Lifting, a QSD framework that addresses both challenges through repetition encoding, neural decoding, and in situ calibration. Encoding supplies joint in-phase and quadrature (I-Q) readout signals from the target and auxiliary qubits, while contextual calibration trains the decoder for the conditions encountered during execution. Our theoretical analysis shows that retaining additional channels from a fixed joint distribution cannot increase Bayes risk and establishes sufficient conditions for contraction of an overlap-based upper bound. Experiments across three IBM processors evaluate the framework on repeated stabilizer measurement, parity-check, and teleportation workloads.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Emerging Technologies (cs.ET); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

summaries.en: The paper introduces Lifting, a quantum-state-discrimination framework for mid-circuit measurements that combines repetition encoding of I-Q readouts, neural decoding, and in-situ contextual calibration to reduce noise-limited and workload-mismatch errors, supported by theory showing non-increasing Bayes risk with additional channels and overlap-bound contraction under sufficient conditions, and validated experimentally on three IBM processors across stabilizer, parity-check, and teleportation tasks.
summaries.zh: 本文提出Lifting框架，用于在中途电路测量中进行量子态判别：通过对I-Q读出进行重复编码、使用神经解码并结合原位的情境化校准来降低噪声受限误差及随执行推进导致的校准失配问题，理论分析表明保留来自固定联合分布的更多通道不会增加贝叶斯风险，并在满足充分条件时可收缩基于重叠的上界，且在三台IBM处理器上对重复稳定子测量、奇偶校验与量子传送等工作负载进行了实验验证。

title: $T$-efficient unitary synthesis via block-sparse Hamiltonian simulation
abstract: We construct Clifford+$T$ circuits implementing arbitrary $n$-qubit unitaries with worst-case $T$-count $\widetilde{O}(N^{8/7})$ at constant operator-norm error, where $N=2^n$, improving the previous exponent $5/4$. The construction uses $\widetilde{O}(N^{6/7})$ clean ancillas. The main idea is to reduce the data addressed by each query to the block-encoding circuit for a sparse piece while controlling the additional simulation work needed to combine the pieces. We simulate a Hermitian logarithm of the target by flattening its traceless part with a two-layer random similarity transformation, randomly partitioning the transformed generator into block-sparse Hermitian pieces, and combining their evolutions using qDRIFT. For a target operator-norm error $\epsilon\in(0,1/2)$, let $L=\log_2(N/\epsilon)$, the qubit count plus the requested bits of accuracy. By successively correcting the approximation error, we obtain a circuit using $\widetilde{O}(N^{8/7}L^{3/7}+NL)$ $T$ gates and $\widetilde{O}(N)$ clean ancillas whenever $L\le N$. We also prove that, at constant precision, the exponent $8/7$ is optimal within a sequential block-SELECT model.

summaries.en: The paper presents a Clifford+T synthesis method for arbitrary n-qubit unitaries using worst-case $O(N^{8/7})$ T gates at constant operator-norm error (with $N=2^n$), employing $O(N^{6/7})$ clean ancillas by simulating a flattened Hermitian logarithm via random similarity transformations, block-sparse partitioning, and qDRIFT, and proves the $8/7$ exponent is optimal at constant precision under a sequential block-SELECT model.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了一种用于任意$n$比特量子幺正的Clifford+T合成方法，在算符范数误差为常数时，其最坏情况下所需的$T$门数为$O(N^{8/7})$（$N=2^n$），并使用$O(N^{6/7})$个干净辅助比特；方法通过对目标幺正的“展平”对数对应的厄米算符进行随机相似变换、块稀疏分块并结合qDRIFT来模拟，同时证明在常精度下该$8/7$指数在顺序块-SELECT模型中是最优的。

title: Explicitly correlated ground states with a feedback-free variational hybrid algorithm
abstract: Explicitly correlated methods, which represent dominant short-range correlations by a diagonal Jastrow-type correlator, are designed to accurately describe systems of strongly correlated electrons, such as the fully periodic 2D Fermi--Hubbard model. However, as the reference state is compact in momentum space whereas the correlator acts naturally in real space, there is a fundamental mismatch of bases that classical algorithms resolve only by restricting the reference or the correlator. Here we propose a hybrid algorithm in which a quantum processor prepares a low-entanglement momentum-space matrix product state (MPS), precomputed classically by the transcorrelated method at the cost of a nonvariational energy, rotates it to real space, and measures in bases fixed by the Hamiltonian. Because the measurement bases are independent of the correlator, the correlator can be variationally optimized entirely in classical post-processing with no quantum-classical feedback loop. We demonstrate our algorithm on 32 qubits of Quantinuum's H2-2 with a bond-dimension-4 MPS for the half-filled $4 \times 4$ lattice and achieve a relative ground-state energy error of $16 \pm 4\%$ after postselection, reduced to $3.5 \pm 0.5\%$ by calibration using low-order moments from the MPS. Compared with other feedback-free hybrid algorithms, even under generous assumptions, our method requires fewer samples than quantum-selected configuration interaction and fewer two-qubit gates than quantum Krylov methods.

summaries.en: The paper presents a feedback-free variational hybrid quantum-classical algorithm that uses a low-entanglement momentum-space MPS prepared on a quantum processor, rotated to real space for Hamiltonian-fixed measurements, while variationally optimizing an explicit real-space Jastrow-type correlator entirely in classical post-processing, demonstrated on a 4×4 2D Fermi–Hubbard system with Quantinuum hardware achieving significantly improved ground-state energy accuracy and favorable sampling/gate costs versus other feedback-free hybrids.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种无反馈的变分型混合量子-经典算法：由量子处理器制备低纠缠的动量空间MPS并旋转到实空间以在由哈密顿量固定的基下测量，同时将实空间Jastrow型显式相关子的变分优化完全放在经典后处理完成；在Quantinuum硬件上对2D 费米-哈伯德4×4半填充体系验证后，地面态能量误差在后选后达16±4%并经基于MPS低阶矩校准降至3.

title: PULSUS: Direct Frequency-Domain Multidimensional Spectroscopy Beyond the Impulsive Rotating-Wave Approximation
abstract: We introduce PULSUS, a direct frequency-domain framework for multidimensional spectroscopy of open quantum systems beyond the impulsive rotating-wave approximation. Coherence-frequency intervals are represented through Liouvillian resolvents, while finite Gaussian pulses are incorporated through operator-valued functions of the field-free Liouvillian. This enables direct evaluation on Cartesian grids or arbitrary spectral coordinates while retaining molecular evolution during the pulse envelopes and, when required, the complete light--matter interaction. The implementation is validated against analytical and independent time-domain benchmarks and supports targeted spectral sampling that reduces the number of evaluated coordinates when the response is spectrally localized. A controlled hierarchy of finite-pulse, rotating-wave, short-pulse, and impulsive models separates the errors introduced by each approximation. For a coupled electronic dimer, the total impulsive-RWA error is nonmonotonic in pulse duration: an intermediate regime provides the highest accuracy, whereas ultrashort pulses expose coupling-enabled beyond-RWA pathways and longer pulses develop substantial finite-pulse corrections. These results show that the impulsive and rotating-wave approximations cannot be assumed to improve simultaneously and should be tested when quantitatively interpreting multidimensional spectra. PULSUS provides a direct frequency-domain framework for carrying out that comparison.

summaries.en: The paper presents PULSUS, a direct frequency-domain multidimensional spectroscopy method for open quantum systems that goes beyond the impulsive rotating-wave approximation by using Liouvillian resolvents and finite-pulse field operator functions, enabling accurate and efficient spectral sampling and revealing nonmonotonic accuracy tradeoffs between finite-pulse and RWA approximations for an electronic dimer.
summaries.zh: 本文提出PULSUS，一种用于开放量子系统的直接频域多维光谱框架，通过用利乌维尔算符的解析型（resolvents）刻画相干频率区间，并用场的、以场自由利乌维尔算符为自变量的算符函数来纳入有限脉冲，从而超越冲量旋转波近似、支持在笛卡尔或任意频谱坐标上的直接评估与定向采样，并通过对电子二聚体的比较证明有限脉冲与RWA近似的误差改进并非同时发生且呈非单调行为，因而解释多维光谱时需分别检验这些近似。

title: Finite-energy two-way assisted capacities: Exact formulas for multimode loss and fading
abstract: We study quantum communication, entanglement distribution, and secret-key generation through multimode bosonic loss and fading channels, assisted by local quantum operations and two-way classical communication. Using sector teleportation, we determine the exact two-way quantum and secret-key capacities of multimode pure-loss channels under a mean photon-number constraint, allowing arbitrary adaptive quantum protocols. We extend these results to continuous frequency-dependent loss under a power constraint and identify the optimal allocation of photons among optical modes. For constant loss over an unlimited bandwidth, we obtain a closed-form capacity proportional to the square root of power. For randomly varying loss, we determine exact finite-energy capacities when the channel realization is publicly revealed, distinguishing knowledge before and after transmission. When fading remains unobserved, we derive capacity bounds and explicit formulas for an on/off channel. We also establish strong-converse bounds, with exact thresholds for the deterministic loss models considered here, observed fading, and unobserved fading with finitely many possible transmissivities. Under mean energy constraints, these thresholds generally exceed the corresponding finite-energy capacities. These results guide energy allocation and provide benchmarks for energy-constrained optical quantum communication with multimode signals and variable loss.

summaries.en: The paper derives exact finite-energy two-way quantum and secret-key capacities for multimode bosonic loss and fading channels under mean or power photon-number constraints, including optimal photon-mode allocations, closed-form regimes for constant loss, exact results with publicly known fading and explicit formulas for unobserved fading, and strong-converse threshold bounds that benchmark energy-constrained optical quantum communication.
summaries.zh: 论文在平均或功率光子数约束下推导了多模玻色失效与衰落信道在两向辅助条件下的精确有限能量量子与秘密密钥容量，给出最优光子在模间的分配、恒定损耗的闭式结果、已公开衰落与未观测衰落情形下的精确/显式公式，并建立强对偶的容量阈值基准以刻画能量受限的光学量子通信。

title: Quantum-enhanced mechanical sensing with machine-learning estimation
abstract: Massive mechanical oscillators couple directly to forces, accelerations and gravity, making them attractive probes of new physics and of quantum mechanics at macroscopic scales. Pushing sensitivities beyond the standard quantum limit for signals of unknown phase requires non-Gaussian quantum states, whose metrological advantage has so far been confined to lighter systems such as trapped ions. Here we operate a microgram-scale acoustic mode of a high-overtone bulk acoustic wave resonator as a phase-insensitive quantum-enhanced sensor. A transmon qubit prepares the mode in Fock states of up to seven phonons by optimal control, and resolves its phonon-number distribution after interaction with a weak resonant signal. Bayesian analysis yields a Fisher information five times the vacuum value, a 7.0 dB gain in signal-amplitude sensitivity over any classical probe state, irrespective of its energy, currently limited by state preparation infidelities. We then train a neural network on the measured sensor response to perform Bayesian estimation without any analytical model of the system, showing the same sensitivity gain with half the systematic bias. Our results establish acoustic resonators prepared in non-Gaussian states as quantum-enhanced probes for high-frequency gravitational waves, dark matter and wave-function collapse.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates a phase-insensitive quantum-enhanced mechanical sensor using a microgram acoustic mode prepared in non-Gaussian Fock states with a transmon qubit, achieving a fivefold Fisher-information increase and a 7 dB amplitude-sensitivity gain via Bayesian estimation, and further shows a neural-network estimator can reproduce the gain with reduced systematic bias.
summaries.zh: 论文利用由跨分子量比特制备的非高斯Fock态来驱动微克级声学振动模，构建了相位不敏感的量子增强机械传感器，通过贝叶斯分析实现五倍的费舍尔信息提升和约7 dB的信号振幅敏感度增益，并进一步证明神经网络估计器在无需解析系统模型的情况下可保持该增益且系统偏差减半。

title: Deterministic and programmable generation of mechanical multipartite entangled states
abstract: Multimode mechanical resonators offer a large set of densely packed, long-lived bosonic modes within a single compact device, making them attractive for quantum simulation, quantum information processing, and quantum-enhanced sensing. Many such applications rely on multipartite entanglement, yet deterministic mechanical entanglement has so far been largely limited to pairs of modes. Here we demonstrate the deterministic and programmable preparation of multipartite entangled states among the phonon modes of a high-overtone bulk acoustic wave resonator coupled to a superconducting transmon qubit. By sequentially applying optimal-control-engineered isometries between the qubit and successive modes, we generate matrix product states of bond dimension two, including $W$, Greenberger-Horne-Zeilinger (GHZ), and cluster states. We fully characterize these states via quantum state tomography and certify genuine multipartite entanglement among up to four modes. We further demonstrate correlated-noise sensing by exploiting the complementary decoherence responses of the stored $W$ and GHZ states, isolating inter-mode phase correlations from local decoherence and placing quantitative bounds on collective dephasing. Our results establish a scalable approach to preparing multipartite entangled states in mechanical systems, with promising applications in multiparameter sensing and tests of quantum mechanics with massive objects.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates deterministic, programmable generation of up to four-mode multipartite phonon entangled states in a bulk acoustic resonator using sequential optimal-control isometries with a transmon qubit, producing and fully characterizing W, GHZ, and cluster matrix product states and certifying genuine multipartite entanglement while also enabling correlated-noise sensing and bounding collective dephasing.
summaries.zh: 论文通过在由超导跨膜（transmon）量子比特耦合的高过音量本体声学谐振器中，利用按顺序施加由最优控制工程化的等距操作来确定性地制备并表征最多四个模的多体声子纠缠态，生成并鉴定W、GHZ和簇态的矩阵乘积态，同时展示利用W与GHZ互补退相干响应进行相关噪声测量并给出集体退相干的定量界限，从而证明该方法在机械系统中可扩展制备多体纠缠态并有望用于多参数测量与大质量物体的量子力学检验。

title: On the coincidence of discrete and continuous definitions of Entanglement of Formation
abstract: It is proved that every Borel ensemble of pure states on a separable bipartite Hilbert space with finite average entanglement admits a countable ensemble with the same barycenter and arbitrarily small additional average entanglement. Consequently, the discrete and continuous versions of the Entanglement of Formation coincide on the whole space of states of infinite-dimensional bipartite quantum system (with infinite values allowed). The main idea of the proof (realized with the AI-assistance) is the identification of a Borel ensemble of pure bipartite states with a Borel probability measure on the unit sphere of the space of Hilbert--Schmidt operators followed by dividing the support of this measure into appropriate cells and replacing each cell by its conditional barycenter. The resulting countable ensemble is obtained by a recursive construction.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Mathematical Physics (math-ph); Functional Analysis (math.FA)

summaries.en: The paper shows that for any separable infinite-dimensional bipartite quantum system, every Borel ensemble of pure states with finite average entanglement can be approximated by a countable ensemble sharing the same barycenter and with arbitrarily small extra average entanglement, implying that the discrete and continuous definitions of Entanglement of Formation coincide across the full state space (allowing infinite values).
summaries.zh: 该论文证明：对任意可分无限维双部量子系统，只要纯态的 Borel 集合具有有限平均纠缠，就总能找到与其具有相同重心（barycenter）且额外平均纠缠任意小的可数集合，从而得出“离散版”和“连续版”纠缠形成量（Entanglement of Formation）在整个状态空间上是一致的（允许取无穷大）；证明思路是将 Borel 态集合对应为希尔伯特—施密特算子空间单位球上的 Borel 概率测度，对测度支撑分割成合适的单元并用各单元的条件重心替换，最终通过递归构造得到该可数集合。

title: Gaussian entanglement and quantum communication: geodesic optimization and multimode bounds
abstract: Loss and noise limit the use of light to distribute entanglement, transmit quantum information, and establish secret keys. Gaussian states have a compact description in terms of means and covariance matrices, but their entanglement still requires global optimization. We develop a framework for computing Gaussian-restricted versions of the relative entropy of entanglement and Rains entanglement. An integral representation reveals a convex geometry under matrix geometric means and reduces Gaussian Rains entanglement to relative entropy minimized over Gaussian states with positive partial transpose. We obtain unique optimal reference states and additivity for independent Gaussian input states. Our convex-majorization algorithm has an explicit geometric convergence rate, uniform in the faithful regularization parameter and valid for pure input states. Controlled numerical integration and approximate convex subproblem solutions give a bit-complexity bound that is polynomial in accuracy bits for each fixed rational input covariance matrix, with explicit dependence on covariance size. These calculations bound extractable entanglement and, through the relative entropy of entanglement, extractable secret key. Teleportation simulation, energy allocation, and a convex optimization of passive-basis loss cores give bounds on quantum and private communication under an input-energy constraint, allowing arbitrary two-way classically assisted protocols. Two- and three-mode examples compare the bounds with achievable rates, including matching pure-loss benchmarks. Finally, we separate the Gaussian-restricted quantities from their unrestricted counterparts and give a photon-number truncation method with controlled error for computing the latter.

summaries.en: The paper develops an efficient convex-optimization and integral-representation framework to compute Gaussian-restricted entanglement measures (relative entropy of entanglement and Rains entanglement), yielding convergence and complexity guarantees, bounds on extractable entanglement/secret key and on two-way quantum-private communication under energy constraints, and extends results beyond Gaussian restrictions via photon-number truncation with controlled error.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出一种高效的凸优化与积分表表示框架，用于计算受高斯限制的纠缠度量（相对熵纠缠与 Rains 纠缠），并给出收敛性与计算复杂度保证，进而在能量约束下对可提取纠缠/秘密密钥以及任意双向经典辅助的量子-私密通信提供上界；同时通过受控误差的光子数截断方法将结果扩展到非高斯情形。

title: Inverse identification of thermal-radiative parameters for reduced effective-temperature uncertainty in an ion optical clock
abstract: The blackbody-radiation (BBR) shift remains a leading systematic uncertainty of room-temperature single-ion optical clocks. Accurate evaluation of this shift requires the effective temperature at the ion position, which is difficult because RF heating, low and spatially varying surface emissivity and inaccessible trap surfaces make this quantity difficult to measure directly. Here, we developed a hybrid inversion framework that combines radiance-domain infrared thermography, black-painted high-emissivity reference regions, a finite-element model of a 171Yb+ end-cap ion trap and a reduced-order surrogate for repeated forward calculations and parameter identification. The surrogate reproduced the FE test fields with a full-field mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.02220 mK. The calibrated model predicted the ion-position effective temperature with a combined standard uncertainty of 155.0 mK, corresponding to a temperature-related BBR frequency-shift uncertainty of 1.647 x 10^-19 for the 2S1/2-2F7/2 (467 nm) E3 transition. This method provides a reproducible route for reducing and tracing the BBR uncertainty of room-temperature trapped-ion optical clocks.

summaries.en: The paper presents a hybrid inversion framework using infrared thermography, high-emissivity reference regions, finite-element modeling of a 171Yb+ ion trap, and a reduced-order surrogate to identify thermal-radiative parameters and thereby predict the ion-position effective temperature with 155.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种结合红外热成像、黑涂高发射率参考区域、171Yb+ 离子陷阱有限元模型以及用于快速正向计算与参数识别的降阶代理模型的混合反演框架，以识别热辐射参数并预测离子位置有效温度，所得合成标准不确定度为 155.

title: Proposal for a multi-ion optical clock with hundreds of ions
abstract: Scaling trapped-ion optical clocks to hundreds of ions remains a major challenge due to inhomogeneous frequency shifts in large ion crystals. Here, we propose a circular surface-trap architecture for a multi-ion optical clock with hundreds of ions. The rotational symmetry of the ion crystal suppresses the main sources of inhomogeneity, quadrupole this http URL investigate the feasibility of a clock based on a ring crystal of 400 $^{40}\mathrm{Ca}^{+}$ ions and propose a suitable experimental setup configuration. We have shown that circular configuration of ions leads to suppression by two orders of magnitude of the quadrupole shift comparing to the linear trap. Combined with stray-field compensation and dynamical decoupling techniques, this architecture provides a pathway toward multi-ion optical clocks with fractional frequency uncertainty at the $10^{-18}$ level and an expected 20-fold improvement in frequency stability compared to single ion clocks.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a circular surface-trap multi-ion optical clock using a ring of 400 Ca+ ions, showing that rotational symmetry suppresses quadrupole-induced inhomogeneous frequency shifts by two orders of magnitude versus a linear trap and, with stray-field compensation and dynamical decoupling, targets 10^-18 fractional frequency uncertainty and about a 20× improvement in stability over single-ion clocks.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种基于圆环400个Ca+离子的圆形表面陷阱多离子光学钟方案，指出由于离子晶体的旋转对称性可将相对线性陷阱的二极/四极（文中为quadrupole）导致的不均匀频移抑制两个数量级，并结合杂散电场补偿与动力学解耦，有望实现10^-18量级分数频率不确定度且相比单离子钟稳定性提高约20倍。

title: Quantum tomography of bright squeezed vacuum via strong-field ionization
abstract: Strong-field physics uses intense optical fields to probe and control electron motion on ultrafast timescales. Recent advances in bright squeezed vacuum have brought macroscopic quantum states of light into the ultrafast strong-field regime, opening prospects for high-harmonic generation and photoionization. Yet linking its phase-space structure to subcycle electron dynamics remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate strong-field tunneling ionization of xenon using a phase-referenced combination of coherent and squeezed fields, with the coherent field defining the ionization clock and quadrature fluctuations of the zero-mean squeezed field providing control. The squeezed field selectively modulates atomic tunneling barriers and electron wave packets, imprinting signatures on photoelectron momentum distributions, number statistics, and energy spectra. Using coincidence measurements of photon number and phase-sensitive photoelectron momentum distributions, we perform quantum state tomography of the driving field by reconstructing its Wigner function. These results establish a bidirectional interface between quantum optics and nonperturbative strong-field electron dynamics, in which the driving quantum field shapes subcycle electron motion while photoionization provides a phase-sensitive probe of the field's quantum state. This work opens new routes toward controlling electron dynamics with quantum light and phase-sensitive quantum state metrology through ultrafast strong-field electron dynamics.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates phase-referenced strong-field tunneling ionization of xenon driven by a coherent-and-squeezed (bright squeezed vacuum) light field, where the coherent component sets an ionization clock and the squeezed quadrature controls subcycle electron tunneling and wave packets, enabling photoelectron observables to be used with coincidence measurements for quantum state tomography that reconstructs the driving field’s Wigner function.
summaries.zh: 本文通过相干光与压缩光的相位参照组合实现由明亮压缩真空驱动的氙原子强场隧穿电离，利用相干分量设定电离“时钟”、压缩猝变量调制亚周期隧穿与电子波包并在光电子动量/数统计/能谱中留下特征，随后借助光子数与相位敏感光电子动量的符合测量对驱动场进行量子态重构，从而重建其维格纳函数，建立了量子光学与非微扰强场电子动力学的双向接口并开辟利用超快强场电子过程进行相位敏感量子态计量的新路径。

title: An Aubry-André localized optical lattice clock
abstract: Optical lattice clocks in space could improve satellite navigation systems and enable new tests of fundamental physics, including gravitational-wave detection and tests of relativity. In microgravity, atoms can tunnel to degenerate neighboring lattice sites, broadening the clock transition and limiting coherence times. We demonstrate Aubry-André localization in a bichromatic optical lattice formed by two magic-wavelength lasers, suppressing tunneling in a horizontal lattice clock emulating free fall. We recover a Fourier-limited clock Rabi spectrum and measure Ramsey coherence times of up to 2 s in shallow lattices, with up to 100-fold improvement over the delocalized regime. These results establish Aubry-André localization as a practical route to controlling tunneling in future space-based clocks, and open a path to operating terrestrial clocks at shallower lattice depths.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates Aubry–André localization in a bichromatic magic-wavelength optical lattice clock to suppress tunneling in microgravity-like conditions, recovering Fourier-limited Rabi spectra and achieving Ramsey coherence times up to 2 s with up to 100× improvement over a delocalized regime, enabling practical control of tunneling for future space and potentially shallower-depth terrestrial atomic clocks.
summaries.zh: 论文在由两束“魔术波长”激光构成的双色光学晶格中实现了Aubry–André局域化，从而在类微重力条件下抑制晶格隧穿；作者恢复了傅里叶极限的钟跃迁Rabi光谱，并在浅晶格中测得最高2 s的Ramsey相干时间，相比去局域化区域实现最高约100倍提升，为未来空间原子钟中对隧穿的可操作调控以及使地面钟在更浅晶格深度工作提供了路径。

title: Collision inside an atom: quantum ion-atom dynamics
abstract: Rydberg atoms occupy a central role in quantum science; their loosely bound outer electron gives rise to properties that enable quantum information processing1 or the formation of exotic molecular bonds2. Beyond these roles, they have been proposed as a neutral platform for the observation of quantum effects in collisions and reactions of the ionic core with neutral particles3, 4, a long-standing goal of ion-based chemistry and physics. However, all of the experimental results so far could be explained using a classical description of the internuclear motion5. Here we demonstrate cold collisions inside a Rydberg helium atom, achieved by merging helium Rydberg and ground-state helium beams and imaging individual scattering events. We resolve the fully quantum-coherent motion and observe matter-wave diffraction and tunnelling-driven shape resonances down to collision energies of 90 mK. In the case of identical helium nuclei, we demonstrate a new regime of identical-particle Mott interference6, where quantum statistics begin to govern the total scattering cross section. For distinct isotopes, we show the breakdown of the Born-Oppenheimer approximation and benchmark parameter-free, state-of-the-art theory. We directly measure the helium isotope ionization-energy difference to be 15.0 +/- 0.1 K. Our experiments establish Rydberg atoms as a platform for the direct observation of quantum dynamics with a general class of ions, atoms and molecules.

summaries.en: The paper reports cold, fully quantum-coherent ion–atom collisions occurring inside Rydberg helium atoms, revealing matter-wave diffraction, tunnelling-driven shape resonances, identical-particle Mott interference, and Born–Oppenheimer breakdown for different isotopes, while directly measuring the helium isotope ionization-energy difference and benchmarking parameter-free theory.
summaries.zh: 本文实现并表征发生在互偶极里德堡氦原子内部的冷却、完全量子相干的离子-原子碰撞，观察到物质波衍射、隧穿驱动的形状共振、相同粒子莫特干涉以及不同同位素下玻恩-奥本海默近似失效，并直接测量氦同位素电离能差同时用无参数的前沿理论进行基准验证。

title: Theory of Sub-Doppler Spectroscopy of Alkali Metal Vapors in the Field of Counterpropagating Bichromatic Laser Beams: Probe Beam Regime
abstract: Sub-Doppler resonances observed in miniature cells ($V \ll 1 cm^3$) with Rb or Cs atoms in the field of counterpropagating bichromatic laser beams are of interest for the creation of a miniature quantum frequency standard (QFS) of the optical range. However, a theory of these resonances that takes into full account the real structure of energy levels in an atom has not yet been constructed, which would make it possible to obtain explicit analytical expressions for the absorption coefficient of the medium. This paper addresses this gap using the density matrix formalism and the algebra of irreducible tensor operators. Namely, we obtained an analytical expression for the absorption coefficient of the probe beam in the presence of a more intense counterpropagating beam (pump-probe regime). Moreover, the calculations were carried out for arbitrary parameters of laser beam polarization, arbitrary angular momenta of optical dipole transitions in the atom and various relaxation processes. The constructed theory allows us to correctly take into account the simultaneous action of various nonlinear optical effects, in contrast to the simplified three-level model of the atom, and also to investigate the partial contribution of each of them to the overall observed resonant circuit. The analysis performed, in particular, made it possible to predict an increase in the amplitude of the sub-Doppler resonance when using counterpropagating light beams with opposite circular polarizations in relation to the configuration of counterpropagating beams with orthogonal linear polarizations, which is often used in practice.

summaries.en: Using a density-matrix and irreducible-tensor-operator framework, the paper derives an analytic probe-beam absorption coefficient for sub-Doppler resonances in Rb/Cs vapors exposed to counterpropagating bichromatic laser beams in the pump–probe regime, incorporating realistic multilevel structure, arbitrary polarization and angular momenta, and multiple relaxation processes to capture nonlinear optical effects and predict enhanced resonance amplitude for opposite circular polarizations versus orthogonal linear polarizations.
summaries.zh: 论文采用密度矩阵与不可约张量算符方法，推导了在泵-探测（更强反向传播场存在）条件下由反向传播双色激光诱导的Rb/Cs蒸汽亚Doppler共振的探测光吸收系数解析表达，考虑了真实多能级结构、任意偏振与光偶极跃迁角动量以及多种弛豫过程以同时刻画非线性光学效应，并预测当两束反向圆偏振相反时相较于常用的反向正交线偏振可增强亚Doppler共振幅度。
